translationRepairs: The next year, when the crown prince was to be enfeoffed, the chief ministers memorialized that the full ceremonial guard should be prepared to announce the event at the ancestral temple. The emperor said: "Previously, when I received my honorific title and made the thanksgiving visit, you had me follow only Emperor Zhenzong of Song's precedent—court dress and riding a horse—which was very light in ritual terms. Why should the crown prince now receive the full ceremonial treatment?"

The next year, when the crown prince was to be invested, the chief ministers memorialized that the full ceremonial guard should be prepared to announce the event at the ancestral temple. The emperor said: "Previously, when I received my honorific title and made the thanksgiving visit, you had me follow only Emperor Zhenzong of Song's precedent—court dress and riding a horse—which was very light in ritual terms. Why should the crown prince now receive the full ceremonial treatment?"
冊皇太子 names documentary investiture of the heir; enfeoffed misreads 冊 as a landed grant, and invested restores the rite named in the sentence.
They all wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet embroidered udumbara-flower shirts, leather belts, silver-brown baggy trousers, brocade serpent sashes, and bore ceremonial blades.
They all wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet embroidered baoxiang-flower shirts, leather belts, silver-brown baggy trousers, brocade serpent sashes, and bore ceremonial blades.
緋繡寶相花衫 names the baoxiang floral motif; udumbara would require 優曇, which is not in the unit.
All wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet embroidered udumbara-flower shirts, leather belts, silver-brown baggy trousers, brocade serpent sashes, and bore ceremonial blades.
All wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet embroidered baoxiang-flower shirts, leather belts, silver-brown baggy trousers, brocade serpent sashes, and bore ceremonial blades.
The same 寶相花 shirts are misread as udumbara; baoxiang-flower is the source motif.

One hundred eight long-march guards wore iron armor and helmets, red brocade vests and brocade arm guards, rode armored horses with red brocade tail covers, and bore golden lances.
長行一百八人 is 108 men; 180 would need 一百八十, and 18 cadre plus 108 matches the 126 of the golden-lance company.
One hundred eighty long-march guards, iron armor, helmets, red brocade vests, brocade arm guards, armored horses with red brocade tail covers, bearing golden lances.
One hundred eight long-march guards, iron armor, helmets, red brocade vests, brocade arm guards, armored horses with red brocade tail covers, bearing golden lances.
一百八人 is 108, not 180; the numeral in the Chinese is unambiguous.

In the sixth month of Mingchang 5 (1194), the Department of State Affairs memorialized, "In Dading 6, when Emperor Shizong returned from the Western Capital, he adopted the Song ritual for a provincial inspection's return to the capital, employing a yellow-banner guard of two thousand men together with the jade and golden carriages, five hundred armored horsemen of the wickerwork company, and forty-two imperial escort officers; thereafter this formation was not used again.

units.en: The formation was divided into four sections. units.literal: It was divided into four sections: the first section, without county magistrates or prefects of offices, used the first three yellow-banner sections directly, then the front band, then Golden Guard gate flags, then the carriage head, then the dragon-terrace escort company, then the Heavenly King, Twelve Earthly Branches, and other flags.

units.zh: 第二節，黃麾第四、第五部，次君王萬歲日月旗，次禦馬，內增控馬司圉、挾馬司圉各一十六人，次日月合璧、五星連珠等旗，次八寶，內增執黑杖傳喝一十八人在香案前，次七寶輦。
units.en: The second section comprised the fourth and fifth yellow-banner sections, then the Myriad Years Sun-and-Moon banner, then the imperial horses—supplemented by sixteen horse handlers each from the horse-control and horse-attendant bureaus—then the Sun-and-Moon Joined in Harmony, Five Stars Linked in a Chain, and related banners, then the Eight Treasures—with eighteen black-staff criers added before the incense table—and finally the Seven-Treasure palanquin.
units.literal: The second section: the fourth and fifth yellow-banner sections, then the Myriad Years Sun-and-Moon banner of lord and king, then imperial horses—with sixteen added horse handlers of the horse-control bureau and sixteen added horse handlers of the horse-attendant bureau—then the Sun-and-Moon Joined in Harmony, Five Stars Linked in a Chain, and other banners, then the Eight Treasures—with eighteen added black-staff criers before the incense table—then the Seven-Treasure palanquin.

units.zh: 第三節，黃麾後第一、第二部，次玉輅，次栲栳隊，次導駕門仗官。
units.en: The third section included the first and second rear yellow-banner sections, followed by the jade carriage, the wickerwork escort company, and the imperial escort gate armed-guard officers.
units.literal: The third section: the first and second rear yellow-banner sections, then the jade carriage, then the wickerwork company, then the imperial escort gate armed-guard officers.

units.zh: 第四節，黃麾後第三、第四、第五部，次金輅，次牙門旗，次後部鼓吹。
units.en: The fourth section comprised the third, fourth, and fifth rear yellow-banner sections, followed by the golden carriage, gate flags, and the rear band.
units.literal: The fourth section: the third, fourth, and fifth rear yellow-banner sections, then the golden carriage, then gate flags, then the rear band.

units.zh: 大定六年九月，西京還都，用黃麾仗二千五百四十二人攝官在內，騎七百六十二匹。
units.en: In the ninth month of Dading 6 (1166), when the court returned from the Western Capital, it employed a yellow-banner guard of 2,542 men, acting officers included, with 762 mounted men.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the sixth year of Dading, on the return from the Western Capital, a yellow-banner armed guard of 2,542 men—including acting officers—was used, with 762 mounts.

units.zh: 分四節：第一節，攝官五十四人，執擎三百二人，樂工一百七十人。
units.en: The guard was divided into four sections. The first section comprised 54 acting officers, 302 bearers, and 170 musicians.
units.literal: It was divided into four sections: the first section had 54 acting officers, 302 bearers, and 170 musicians.

units.literal: The second section: 32 acting officers and 376 bearers.

units.zh: 第三節，仗內攝官四十四人，導駕官四十二人。
units.en: The third section included 44 acting officers within the guard formation and 42 imperial escort officers.
units.literal: The third section: 44 acting officers within the armed guard and 42 imperial escort officers.

units.zh: 門仗官一百人，玉輅青馬八、駕士一百四十人，護駕栲隊五百人，執擎二百四十二人。
units.en: It also included 100 gate armed-guard officers; eight blue horses and 140 drivers for the jade carriage; a 500-man wickerwork escort company; and 242 bearers.
units.literal: 100 gate armed-guard officers; eight blue horses for the jade carriage and 140 drivers; 500 wickerwork escort guards for the carriage; and 242 bearers.

units.zh: 第四節，攝官五十人，金輅赤馬八、駕士九十四人，控鶴二十二人，樂工八十四人，執擎二百九十人。
units.en: The fourth section comprised 50 acting officers; eight red horses and 94 drivers for the golden carriage; 22 crane handlers; 84 musicians; and 290 bearers.
units.literal: The fourth section: 50 acting officers; eight red horses for the golden carriage and 94 drivers; 22 crane handlers; 84 musicians; and 290 bearers.

units.zh: 是歲，上還自西京，有司備儀仗，皇太子乘綴輅，上疑其非禮，以問禮官，無能知者，上怒，皆責降之。
units.en: That year, when the emperor returned from the Western Capital, the responsible offices prepared the ceremonial escort, and the crown prince rode in the ornamented carriage. The emperor suspected this violated proper ritual and questioned the ritual officials, but none could explain it. Enraged, he demoted them all.
units.literal: That year, when the emperor returned from the Western Capital, the relevant offices prepared the ceremonial guard, and the crown prince rode in the ornamented carriage. The emperor suspected this was not proper ritual and questioned the ritual officials, but none could answer. The emperor was angry and demoted them all.

units.zh: 明年，將冊皇太子，宰臣奏當備儀仗告廟，上曰：「前朕受尊號謁謝，但令朕用宋真宗故事，朝服乘馬，於禮甚輕，今皇太子乃用備禮何耶？」
units.en: The following year, as the crown prince was to be formally invested, the chief ministers memorialized that the full ceremonial guard should be prepared for the announcement at the ancestral temple. The emperor said, "When I received my honorific title and made the thanksgiving visit, you had me follow only Emperor Zhenzong of the Song—court dress and on horseback—a very light observance by ritual standards. Why should the crown prince now receive the full ceremonial treatment?"
units.literal: The next year, when the crown prince was to be invested, the chief ministers memorialized that the full ceremonial guard should be prepared to announce the event at the ancestral temple. The emperor said: "Previously, when I received my honorific title and made the thanksgiving visit, you had me follow only Emperor Zhenzong of Song's precedent—court dress and riding a horse—which was very light in ritual terms. Why should the crown prince now receive the full ceremonial treatment?"

units.zh: 丞相良弼謝，上徐曰：「此文臣因循，不加意爾。」
units.en: Chief Councillor Liangbi apologized. The emperor said slowly, "The civil officials simply follow precedent without thinking—that is all."
units.literal: Chief Councillor Liangbi apologized. The emperor said slowly: "This is because the civil officials follow precedent mechanically and pay no attention."

units.zh: 先是，凡行幸皆役民執仗，是後詔以軍士易之。
units.en: Previously, whenever the emperor went on progress, commoners were conscripted to carry the guard equipment; thereafter an edict ordered soldiers substituted in their place.
units.literal: Previously, whenever the emperor traveled, commoners were conscripted to bear the armed guard; thereafter an edict replaced them with soldiers.

units.zh: 大定十一年，將有事於南郊，朝享太廟，右丞石琚奏其禮，上曰：「前朝漢人祭天，惟務整肅儀仗，此自奉耳，非敬天也。
units.en: In Dading 11 (1171), as the court prepared for the Southern Suburb sacrifice and an offering at the Grand Ancestral Temple, Right Vice Councillor Shi Jue presented the ritual program. The emperor said, "Under the previous dynasty, the Han worshiped Heaven by striving only to make the ceremonial escort imposing. That was self-display, not reverence for Heaven.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Dading, when rites were to be performed at the Southern Suburb and the emperor was to offer at the Grand Ancestral Temple, Right Vice Councillor Shi Jue presented the ritual program. The emperor said: "In the previous dynasty the Han people worshiped Heaven by striving only to make the ceremonial guard imposing. That was self-display, not reverence for Heaven.

units.zh: 朕謂祭天在誠，不在儀仗之盛也，其減半用之。」
units.en: I hold that worshiping Heaven lies in sincerity, not in the grandeur of the guard. Use half the usual force."
units.literal: I hold that worshiping Heaven lies in sincerity, not in the grandeur of the armed guard; use half the force."

units.zh: 於是，遂增損黃麾仗為大駕鹵簿，凡用七千人攝官在內，分八節。
units.en: Thereupon the yellow-banner guard was revised into the Grand Carriage Guard of Honor, totaling seven thousand men, acting officers included, in eight sections.
units.literal: Thereupon the yellow-banner armed guard was revised and increased to become the grand carriage guard of honor, using 7,000 men in all—including acting officers—divided into eight sections.

units.zh: 栲栳隊五百人：內金槍隊一百二十六人，分左右，人員十八、並鐵甲、皁帽、紅錦背子，執小旗，馬甲，紅錦包尾。
units.en: Wickerwork escort company: 500 men, including a Golden Lance company of 126 men divided left and right, with eighteen cadre in iron armor and black caps, red brocade vests, small banners, horse armor, and red brocade tail covers.
units.literal: Wickerwork company, 500 men: including Golden Lance company, 126 men, divided left and right, with eighteen cadre, all in iron armor and black caps, red brocade vests, bearing small banners, horse armor, and red brocade tail covers.

units.zh: 長行一百八人，鐵甲、兜牟、紅錦背子、錦臂鞲，甲馬、紅錦包尾，執金槍。
units.en: One hundred eight long-march guards wore iron armor and helmets, red brocade vests and brocade arm guards, rode armored horses with red brocade tail covers, and bore golden lances.
units.literal: One hundred eight long-march guards, iron armor, helmets, red brocade vests, brocade arm guards, armored horses with red brocade tail covers, bearing golden lances.

units.zh: 銀槍隊一百二十六人，人員十八、長行一百八人，服並如上，銀槍。
units.en: Silver Lance company: 126 men, with eighteen cadre and one hundred eight long-march guards dressed as above, bearing silver lances.
units.literal: Silver Lance company, 126 men, with eighteen cadre and one hundred eight long-march guards; dress as above, with silver lances.

units.zh: 弓箭直步隊一百二十四人，人員四、鐵甲、皁帽、紅錦團花戰袍、弓矢，執銀骨朵，馬甲全。
units.en: Bow-and-arrow Direct Foot company: 124 men, with four cadre in iron armor and black caps, red brocade floral battle robes, bow and arrows, silver maces, and full horse armor.
units.literal: Bow-and-arrow Direct Foot company, 124 men, with four cadre, iron armor, black caps, red brocade floral battle robes, bow and arrows, bearing silver maces, and full horse armor.

units.zh: 長行一百二十人，鐵笠、紅錦團花戰袍、鐵甲、弓矢、骨朵。
units.en: One hundred twenty long-march guards wore iron conical hats, red brocade floral battle robes, and iron armor, and carried bow and arrows and maces.
units.literal: One hundred twenty long-march guards, iron conical hats, red brocade floral battle robes, iron armor, bow and arrows, and maces.

units.zh: 骨朵直步隊一百二十四人，人員四、長行一百二十人。
units.en: Mace Direct Foot company: 124 men, with four cadre and one hundred twenty long-march guards.
units.literal: Mace Direct Foot company, 124 men, with four cadre and one hundred twenty long-march guards.

units.zh: 服甲同上，無弓矢。
units.en: Their dress and armor matched those described above, but without bow and arrows.
units.literal: Dress and armor as above, without bow and arrows.

units.zh: 金吾牙門旗二十人，黃麾後第一部一百五十人，第二部一百二十人，殳叉仗五十二人，行止旗一。
units.en: Golden Guard gate flags: 20 men; first rear yellow-banner section: 150 men; second section: 120 men; shu-and-fork armed guard: 52 men; one halt-and-proceed banner.
units.literal: Golden Guard gate flags, 20 men; first rear yellow-banner section, 150 men; second section, 120 men; shu-and-fork armed guard, 52 men; one halt-and-proceed banner.

units.zh: 第七節。
units.en: Seventh section.
units.literal: Seventh section.

units.zh: 扇筤二十五人，金輅九十四人。
units.en: Fan racks: 25 men; golden carriage: 94 men.
units.literal: Fan racks, 25 men; golden carriage, 94 men.

units.zh: 大安輦一百八十一人：內尚輦奉禦二人，殿中少監二人，奉職官二人，並公服。
units.en: Great Tranquility palanquin: 181 men, including two directors of the imperial carriage service, two vice directors of the palace service, and two fengzhi officials, all in official dress.
units.literal: Great Tranquility palanquin, 181 men: including two directors of the imperial carriage service, two vice directors of the palace service, and two fengzhi officials, all in official dress.

units.zh: 令史四人，書令史四人，七人烏介幘、緋四䙆素衫、銀褐抹帶、大口袴、皁靴，一人長腳襆頭、紫羅公服、角帶皁靴。
units.en: Four clerks and four document clerks; seven wore black border kerchiefs, scarlet four-panel plain shirts, silver-brown waist bands, baggy trousers, and black boots; one wore a long-foot wrapped headcloth, purple silk official dress, horn belt, and black boots.
units.literal: Four clerks and four document clerks; seven men in black border kerchiefs, scarlet four-panel plain shirts, silver-brown waist bands, baggy trousers, and black boots; one man in long-foot wrapped headcloth, purple silk official dress, horn belt, and black boots.

units.zh: 掌輦四人，武弁、黃繡寶相花衫、銀褐抹帶、大口袴。
units.en: Four palanquin attendants wore military caps, yellow embroidered baoxiang-flower shirts, silver-brown waist bands, and baggy trousers.
units.literal: Four palanquin attendants, military caps, yellow embroidered baoxiang-flower shirts, silver-brown waist bands, and baggy trousers.

units.zh: 人員十二，皁帽、紅錦團襖、銅束帶，內指揮使一人執銀骨朵。
units.en: Twelve cadre wore black caps, red brocade padded jackets, and copper belts, including one section commander bearing a silver mace.
units.literal: Twelve cadre, black caps, red brocade padded jackets, copper belts; including one section commander bearing a silver mace.

units.zh: 舁士一百五十一人。
units.en: One hundred fifty-one bearers.
units.literal: One hundred fifty-one bearers.

units.zh: 服同掌輦。
units.en: Their dress matched that of the palanquin attendants.
units.literal: Dress the same as palanquin attendants.

units.zh: 禦馬三十三人。
units.en: Imperial horses: 33 men.
units.literal: Imperial horses, 33 men.

units.zh: 持鈒隊三十九人。
units.en: Bell-bearing company: 39 men.
units.literal: Bell-bearing company, 39 men.

units.zh: 後部鼓吹一百六十人。
units.en: Rear band: 160 men.
units.literal: Rear band, 160 men.

units.zh: 黃麾後第三至第五部皆一百二十人。
units.en: Third through fifth rear yellow-banner sections: 120 men each.
units.literal: Third through fifth rear yellow-banner sections, 120 men each.

units.zh: 後步甲隊第一至第二隊皆四十二人。
units.en: Rear foot-armor companies: the first and second companies had 42 men each.
units.literal: Rear foot-armor companies, first and second companies, 42 men each.

units.zh: 殳叉五十六人。
units.en: Fifty-six shu and forks.
units.literal: Fifty-six shu and forks.

units.zh: 行止旗一。
units.en: One halt-and-proceed banner.
units.literal: One halt-and-proceed banner.

units.zh: 第八節。
units.en: Eighth section.
units.literal: Eighth section.

units.zh: 後部鼓吹第二，一百四十人。
units.en: Second rear band: 140 men.
units.literal: Second rear band, 140 men.

units.zh: 象輅、革車、木輅皆五十人，進賢車二十六人，豹尾車一十八人，屬車八十人。
units.en: Elephant carriage, leather carriage, and wooden carriage: 50 men each; Worthy Advance carriage: 26 men; leopard-tail carriage: 18 men; follow carriages: 80 men.
units.literal: Elephant carriage, leather carriage, and wooden carriage, 50 men each; Worthy Advance carriage, 26 men; leopard-tail carriage, 18 men; follow carriages, 80 men.

units.zh: 玄武隊六十一人。
units.en: Dark Warrior company: 61 men.
units.literal: Dark Warrior company, 61 men.

units.zh: 後步甲隊第三至第五隊皆四十二人。
units.en: Rear foot-armor companies: the third through fifth companies had 42 men each.
units.literal: Rear foot-armor companies, third through fifth companies, 42 men each.

units.zh: 金吾牙門旗二十人。
units.en: Golden Guard gate flags: 20 men.
units.literal: Golden Guard gate flags, 20 men.

units.zh: 後部馬隊第一隊七十六人，第二隊六十四人，第三隊六十人。
units.en: Rear mounted companies: the first company had 76 men, the second 64, and the third 60.
units.literal: Rear mounted companies: first company 76 men, second company 64 men, third company 60 men.

units.zh: 殳叉仗六十人。
units.en: Shu-and-fork armed guard: 60 men.
units.literal: Shu-and-fork armed guard, 60 men.

units.zh: 行止旗一。
units.en: One halt-and-proceed banner.
units.literal: One halt-and-proceed banner.

units.zh: 後分行旗、止旗為二。
units.en: In the rear, the march banner and halt banner were now two separate banners.
units.literal: In the rear, the march banner and halt banner were made two.

units.zh: 以上名數與黃麾同者不重述。
units.en: Titles and numbers identical to those of the yellow-banner guard are not repeated here.
units.literal: Titles and numbers identical to those of the yellow-banner guard are not repeated above.

units.zh: 章宗明昌五年六月，尚書省奏：「大定六年，世宗自西京還都，采宋省方還京之儀，用黃麾仗二千人、及金玉輅、栲栳隊甲騎五百人、導駕官四十二員，自後遂不復用。
units.en: In the sixth month of Mingchang 5 (1194), the Department of State Affairs memorialized, "In Dading 6, when Emperor Shizong returned from the Western Capital, he adopted the Song ritual for a provincial inspection's return to the capital, employing a yellow-banner guard of two thousand men together with the jade and golden carriages, five hundred armored horsemen of the wickerwork company, and forty-two imperial escort officers; thereafter this formation was not used again.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year of Mingchang under Emperor Zhangzong, the Department of State Affairs memorialized: "In the sixth year of Dading, when Emperor Shizong returned from the Western Capital, adopting the Song ritual for returning to the capital after inspecting the provinces, he used a yellow-banner armed guard of 2,000 men, together with the jade and golden carriages, 500 armored horsemen of the wickerwork company, and 42 imperial escort officers; thereafter it was no longer used.

units.zh: 今車駕幸景明宮，還都之日宜依用之。」
units.en: Now that the imperial carriage is visiting Jingming Palace, the return to the capital should follow this precedent."
units.literal: Now that the imperial carriage is visiting Jingming Palace, on the day of return to the capital it is appropriate to employ it according to this precedent."

units.zh: 制可。
units.en: The emperor approved.
units.literal: The decree approved it.

units.zh: 承安元年，省臣奏：「南郊大禮，大駕鹵簿當用人二萬一千二百一十八、馬八千一百九十八。
units.en: In Cheng'an 1 (1196), the ministers of the Department of State Affairs memorialized, "For the great Southern Suburb rite, the Grand Carriage Guard of Honor should employ 21,218 men and 8,198 horses.
units.literal: In the first year of Cheng'an, provincial ministers memorialized: "For the great rite at the Southern Suburb, the grand carriage guard of honor should employ 21,218 men and 8,198 horses.

units.zh: 世宗親行郊祀，仗用七千人。
units.en: When Emperor Shizong personally performed the suburban sacrifice, the guard numbered seven thousand men.
units.literal: When Emperor Shizong personally performed the suburban sacrifice, the armed guard used was 7,000 men.

units.zh: 今擬大定制外量添甲卒三百，栲栳隊、執楇人二百四十八，通七千五百四十八人，仍分八節。」
units.en: It is now proposed that beyond the great regular regulations an additional three hundred armored soldiers and two hundred forty-eight wickerwork company and pole-bearers be added, for a total of seven thousand five hundred forty-eight men still in eight sections."
units.literal: It is now proposed that beyond the great regular regulations an additional 300 armored soldiers be allotted, and 248 men of the wickerwork company and pole-bearers, totaling 7,548 men, still divided into eight sections."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The court approved.
units.literal: The memorial was approved.

units.zh: 泰和六年，上欲親行祫享，命有司計其役費，尚書省奏：「當用仗三千五百人，錢一萬余貫，馬八百六十五匹。
units.en: In Taihe 6 (1206), when the emperor wished to perform the joint ancestral sacrifice in person, he ordered the relevant offices to calculate the costs. The Department of State Affairs memorialized, "The guard would require three thousand five hundred men, more than ten thousand strings of cash, and eight hundred sixty-five horses.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Taihe, when the emperor wished to perform the joint ancestral sacrifice in person, he ordered the relevant offices to calculate the labor costs. The Department of State Affairs memorialized: "The armed guard should use 3,500 men, more than 10,000 strings of cash, and 865 horses.

units.zh: 舊例，馬皆借取於民，親軍、班祗皆自備從事。
units.en: By old precedent, horses were borrowed from the populace, and personal guards and attendants supplied their own equipment.
units.literal: By old precedent, horses were all borrowed from the populace, and personal guards and attendants all supplied their own equipment.

units.zh: 今軍旅方興，官馬以備緩急，不可借用，民亦不可重擾，宜令有司攝事。」
units.en: Now that military campaigns were underway, government horses were reserved for emergencies and could not be borrowed, nor could the people be burdened again. The relevant offices should handle matters provisionally."
units.literal: Now that military campaigns are underway, government horses are reserved for emergencies and cannot be borrowed; the people also cannot be heavily burdened again. The relevant offices should be ordered to handle matters provisionally."

units.zh: 上詔再議之。
units.en: The emperor ordered further deliberation.
units.literal: The emperor ordered further deliberation.

units.zh: 八年四月，禘於太廟，依元年例，用黃麾仗三千人，屯門仗五百人。
units.en: In the fourth month of the eighth year, at the di sacrifice in the Grand Ancestral Temple, following the first-year precedent, a yellow-banner guard of three thousand men and a garrison-gate guard of five hundred men were employed.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the eighth year, at the di sacrifice in the Grand Ancestral Temple, following the precedent of the first year, a yellow-banner armed guard of 3,000 men and a garrison-gate armed guard of 500 men were used.

units.zh: 皇太后皇后鹵簿
units.en: Empress Dowager and Empress Guard of Honor
units.literal: Empress dowager and empress guard of honor

units.zh: 用唐、宋制，共二千八百四十人。
units.en: Following Tang and Song regulations, the total was two thousand eight hundred forty men.
units.literal: Following Tang and Song regulations, 2,840 men in all.

units.zh: 清旅隊三十人，清遊旗一，執一人、引二人、夾二人。
units.en: Clear Procession company: thirty men; one Clear Procession banner with one bearer, two escorts, and two flankers.
units.literal: Clear Procession company, 30 men; one Clear Procession banner, with one bearer, two escorts, and two flankers.

units.zh: 並平巾幘、緋裲襠、大口袴、佩弓矢、橫刀、執槊、弩、騎。
units.en: They all wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet cross-strap jackets, and baggy trousers, carried bow and arrows and horizontal blades, bore spears and crossbows, and rode.
units.literal: All wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet cross-strap jackets, baggy trousers, bow and arrows at the belt, horizontal blades, bore spears and crossbows, and rode.

units.zh: 次金吾衛折沖都尉一人，平巾幘、紫槊襠、大口袴、錦螣蛇、弓矢、橫刀。
units.en: Next came one Golden Guard assault-resistance commandant in a flat-cap kerchief, purple spear jacket, baggy trousers, brocade serpent sash, bow and arrows, and horizontal blade.
units.literal: Next, one assault-resistance commandant of the Golden Guard, with flat-cap kerchief, purple spear jacket, baggy trousers, brocade serpent sash, bow and arrows, and horizontal blade.

units.zh: 皞槊二人，平巾幘、緋衫、大口褲，夾折沖。
units.en: Two bright-spear bearers in flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet shirts, and baggy trousers flanked the assault-resistance commandant.
units.literal: Two bright-spear bearers, flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet shirts, baggy trousers, flanking the assault-resistance commandant.

units.zh: 領四十騎：二十人執槊、四人弩、十六人橫刀。
units.en: He led forty mounted men: twenty bore spears, four crossbows, and sixteen horizontal blades.
units.literal: Leading forty mounted men: twenty bore spears, four crossbows, and sixteen horizontal blades.

units.zh: 並平巾幘、緋裲襠、大口袴、橫刀、弓矢。
units.en: They all wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet cross-strap jackets, baggy trousers, horizontal blades, and bow and arrows.
units.literal: All wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet cross-strap jackets, baggy trousers, horizontal blades, and bow and arrows.

units.zh: 次虞候佽飛二十八人。
units.en: Next came twenty-eight scout Swift-Flying men.
units.literal: Next, twenty-eight scout Swift-Flying men.

units.zh: 並平巾幘、緋裲襠、大口袴、弓矢、橫刀，騎夾道，分左右均布至黃麾仗。
units.en: They all wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet cross-strap jackets, baggy trousers, bow and arrows, and horizontal blades, riding along both sides of the route and evenly deployed left and right up to the yellow-banner guard.
units.literal: All wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet cross-strap jackets, baggy trousers, bow and arrows, and horizontal blades, riding along both sides of the route and evenly deployed left and right up to the yellow-banner armed guard.

units.zh: 次內僕令一人，丞一人，依本品服，分左右。
units.en: Next came one director of inner attendants and one assistant director, dressed according to rank, positioned left and right.
units.literal: Next, one director of inner attendants and one assistant director, dressed according to their ranks, divided left and right.

units.zh: 各書令史二人。
units.en: Each was accompanied by two document clerks.
units.literal: Two document clerks for each.

units.zh: 平巾幘、緋衫、大口褲，騎從。
units.en: They wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet shirts, and baggy trousers and rode in attendance.
units.literal: Flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet shirts, baggy trousers, riding in attendance.

units.zh: 次黃麾一，執一人，夾二人。
units.en: Next came one yellow banner with one bearer and two flankers.
units.literal: Next, one yellow banner, with one bearer and two flankers.

units.zh: 武弁、硃衣、革帶，正道騎。
units.en: They wore military caps, vermilion robes, and leather belts and rode on the central route.
units.literal: Military caps, vermilion robes, leather belts, riding on the central route.

units.zh: 次左右廂黃麾仗，廂各三行，行百人，從內第一行，短戟、五色氅，執者並黃地白花綦襖、帽、行縢、鞋、襪。
units.en: Next came the left and right wing yellow-banner guards, each wing with three ranks of one hundred men; the inner first rank bore short halberds and five-colored mantles, all wearing yellow-ground white-flower patterned jackets, caps, leggings, shoes, and stockings.
units.literal: Next, left and right wing yellow-banner armed guards; each wing had three ranks of 100 men per rank; from the inner first rank, short halberds and five-colored mantles; bearers all wore yellow-ground white-flower patterned jackets, caps, leggings, shoes, and stockings.

units.zh: 次外第二行，戈、五色氅，執人並赤地黃花綦襖、帽、行縢鞋、襪。
units.en: The outer second rank bore ge halberds and five-colored mantles, all wearing red-ground yellow-flower patterned jackets, caps, leggings, shoes, and stockings.
units.literal: Next, the outer second rank, ge halberds and five-colored mantles; bearers all wore red-ground yellow-flower patterned jackets, caps, leggings, shoes, and stockings.

units.zh: 次外第三行，儀鍠、五色幡。
units.en: The outer third rank bore ceremonial axes and five-colored pennants.
units.literal: Next, the outer third rank, ceremonial axes and five-colored pennants.

units.zh: 並青地赤花綦襖、帽、鞋、行縢、鞋、襪。
units.en: They all wore blue-ground red-flower patterned jackets, caps, leggings, shoes, and stockings.
units.literal: All wore blue-ground red-flower patterned jackets, caps, shoes, leggings, shoes, and stockings.

units.zh: 次左右領軍衛、左右威衛、左右武衛、左右驍衛、左右衛等，衛各三行，行二十人，分前、後。
units.en: Next came the Left and Right Army Supervisory, Majestic, Martial, Valiant, and Standard Guards, each with three ranks of twenty men divided front and rear.
units.literal: Next, the Left and Right Army Supervisory Guards, Left and Right Majestic Guards, Left and Right Martial Guards, Left and Right Valiant Guards, Left and Right Guards, and so on; each guard had three ranks of 20 men per rank, divided front and rear.

units.zh: 衛各主帥六人，唯左右領軍衛各三人，並平巾幘、緋裲襠、大口袴，領軍衛前後獅子文袍、帽、余衛豹文袍、帽，各執鍮石裝長刀，騎領，分前、後。
units.en: Each guard had six troop-leading officers, except the Army Supervisory Guards with three each; all wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet cross-strap jackets, and baggy trousers; Army Supervisory officers front and rear wore lion-pattern robes and caps, the others leopard-pattern robes and caps; each bore long blades with bronze-stone fittings and rode at the head, divided front and rear.
units.literal: Each guard had six troop-leading officers, except the Left and Right Army Supervisory Guards with three each; all wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet cross-strap jackets, and baggy trousers; the Army Supervisory Guards front and rear wore lion-pattern robes and caps, the other guards leopard-pattern robes and caps; each bore long blades with bronze-stone fittings, riding at the head, divided front and rear.

units.zh: 每衛各果毅都尉一人檢校。
units.en: Each guard had one resolute commandant to inspect the formation.
units.literal: Each guard had one resolute commandant to inspect.

units.zh: 被繡袍，以上各一名步從。
units.en: Wearing embroidered robes, each of the above had one foot attendant.
units.literal: Wearing embroidered robes; each of the above had one foot attendant.

units.zh: 左右領軍衛有絳引幡，引前、掩後各三。
units.en: The Army Supervisory Guards had scarlet lead banners: three leading in front and three covering the rear.
units.literal: The Left and Right Army Supervisory Guards had scarlet lead banners, three leading in front and three covering the rear.

units.zh: 執者六人，並平巾幘、緋衫、大口袴。
units.en: Six bearers, all in flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet shirts, and baggy trousers.
units.literal: Six bearers, all with flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet shirts, and baggy trousers.

units.zh: 次內謁者監四人，給事二人，內常侍二人，內侍少監二人。
units.en: Next came four directors of inner chamberlains, two attendants, two inner regular attendants, and two vice directors of inner attendants.
units.literal: Next, four directors of inner chamberlains, two attendants, two inner regular attendants, and two vice directors of inner attendants.

units.zh: 並騎，分左右。
units.en: They all rode, positioned left and right.
units.literal: All rode, divided left and right.

units.zh: 以上各有內給使一人，步從。
units.en: Each of the above had one inner attendant walking in attendance.
units.literal: Each of the above had one inner attendant, walking in attendance.

units.zh: 次內給使百二十人。
units.en: Next came one hundred twenty inner attendants.
units.literal: Next, 120 inner attendants.

units.zh: 皆宮人，並平巾幘、緋衫、大口袴，分左右，在車後。
units.en: All were palace women in flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet shirts, and baggy trousers, positioned left and right behind the carriage.
units.literal: All were palace women, with flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet shirts, and baggy trousers, divided left and right behind the carriage.

units.zh: 次偏扇、團扇、方扇各二十四。
units.en: Next came twenty-four each of side fans, round fans, and square fans.
units.literal: Next, twenty-four each of side fans, round fans, and square fans.

units.zh: 分左右，以宮人執之，皆服間彩大袖裙襦、彩衣、革帶、履。
units.en: Divided left and right and borne by palace women, all wearing multicolored large-sleeved jackets and skirts, colored robes, leather belts, and shoes.
units.literal: Divided left and right, borne by palace women, all wearing multicolored large-sleeved jackets and skirts, colored robes, leather belts, and shoes.

units.zh: 次香蹬一，執擎內給使四人。
units.en: Next came one incense stand, borne by four inner attendants.
units.literal: Next, one incense stand, borne by four inner attendants.

units.zh: 平巾幘 、緋裲襠、大口袴，在重翟車前。
units.en: They wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet cross-strap jackets, and baggy trousers and were positioned before the Heavy Pheasant carriage.
units.literal: Flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet cross-strap jackets, baggy trousers, positioned before the Heavy Pheasant carriage.

units.zh: 次重翟車，馬四，駕士二十四人。
units.en: Next came the Heavy Pheasant carriage with four horses and twenty-four drivers.
units.literal: Next, the Heavy Pheasant carriage, four horses, twenty-four drivers.

units.zh: 平巾幘、青衫、大口褲、鞋襪。
units.en: They wore flat-cap kerchiefs, blue shirts, baggy trousers, and shoes and stockings.
units.literal: Flat-cap kerchiefs, blue shirts, baggy trousers, shoes and stockings.

units.zh: 次行障二，坐障二。
units.en: Next came two marching screens and two seated screens.
units.literal: Next, two marching screens and two seated screens.

units.zh: 分左右夾車，宮人執之。
units.en: Divided left and right to flank the carriage, borne by palace women.
units.literal: Divided left and right flanking the carriage, borne by palace women.

units.zh: 服同執扇。
units.en: Their dress matched that of the fan bearers.
units.literal: Dress the same as fan bearers.

units.zh: 次內寺伯二人，領寺人六。
units.en: Next came two inner temple stewards leading six temple attendants.
units.literal: Next, two inner temple stewards leading six temple attendants.

units.zh: 分左右，平巾幘、緋裲襠、大口袴、執禦刀，並騎，夾重翟車。
units.en: Divided left and right, they wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet cross-strap jackets, and baggy trousers, bore imperial blades, rode, and flanked the Heavy Pheasant carriage.
units.literal: Divided left and right, flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet cross-strap jackets, baggy trousers, bearing imperial blades, all riding and flanking the Heavy Pheasant carriage.

units.zh: 次腰輿一，輿士八人，團雉扇二。
units.en: Next came one waist palanquin with eight bearers and two round pheasant-tail fans.
units.literal: Next, one waist palanquin, eight palanquin bearers, two round pheasant-tail fans.

units.zh: 夾輿。
units.en: Flanking the palanquin.
units.literal: Flanking the palanquin.

units.zh: 次大傘四，次大雉扇八。
units.en: Next came four great umbrellas, then eight great pheasant-tail fans.
units.literal: Next, four great umbrellas, then eight great pheasant-tail fans.

units.zh: 分左右，橫行為二重。
units.en: Divided left and right, they marched crosswise in two ranks.
units.literal: Divided left and right, marching crosswise in two ranks.

units.zh: 次錦華蓋二。
units.en: Next came two brocade flower canopies.
units.literal: Next, two brocade flower canopies.

units.zh: 單行，正道。
units.en: They marched in a single file on the central route.
units.literal: In a single file on the central route.

units.zh: 次小雉扇、硃團扇各十二。
units.en: Next came twelve each of small pheasant-tail fans and vermilion round fans.
units.literal: Next, twelve each of small pheasant-tail fans and vermilion round fans.

units.zh: 並橫行，分左右。
units.en: They all marched crosswise, divided left and right.
units.literal: All marched crosswise, divided left and right.

units.zh: 次錦曲蓋二十四。
units.en: Next came twenty-four brocade curved canopies.
units.literal: Next, twenty-four brocade curved canopies.

units.zh: 橫行，為二重。
units.en: They marched crosswise in two ranks.
units.literal: Marching crosswise in two ranks.

units.zh: 次錦六柱八扇。
units.en: Next came brocade six-pillar eight-fan screens.
units.literal: Next, brocade six-pillar eight-fan screens.

units.zh: 分左右。
units.en: Divided left and right.
units.literal: Divided left and right.

units.zh: 自腰輿以下並內給使執之，服同前。
units.en: From the waist palanquin downward, inner attendants bore all items, dressed as before.
units.literal: From the waist palanquin downward, all were borne by inner attendants, with dress as before.

units.zh: 次宮人車。
units.en: Next came the palace women's carriages.
units.literal: Next, palace women's carriages.

units.zh: 次絳麾二。
units.en: Next came two scarlet banners.
units.literal: Next, two scarlet banners.

units.zh: 分左右，執各一人，武弁、硃衣、革帶、鞋襪。
units.en: Divided left and right with one bearer each, wearing military caps, vermilion robes, leather belts, and shoes and stockings.
units.literal: Divided left and right, one bearer each, military caps, vermilion robes, leather belts, shoes and stockings.

units.zh: 次後黃麾一，執一人，夾二人。
units.en: Next came one rear yellow banner with one bearer and two flankers.
units.literal: Next, one rear yellow banner, with one bearer and two flankers.

units.zh: 並騎，武弁、硃衣、革帶，正道。
units.en: They all rode on the central route in military caps, vermilion robes, and leather belts.
units.literal: All rode, with military caps, vermilion robes, leather belts, on the central route.

units.zh: 次供奉宮人。
units.en: Next came the palace women in attendance.
units.literal: Next, palace women in attendance.

units.zh: 在黃麾後。
units.en: They followed behind the yellow banner.
units.literal: Behind the yellow banner.

units.zh: 次厭翟車，馬四，駕士二十四人。
units.en: Next came the Suppressed Pheasant carriage with four horses and twenty-four drivers.
units.literal: Next, the Suppressed Pheasant carriage, four horses, twenty-four drivers.

units.zh: 次翟車、安車 皆四馬，駕士各二十四人。
units.en: Next came the Pheasant carriage and Tranquility carriage, each with four horses and twenty-four drivers.
units.literal: Next, the Pheasant carriage and Tranquility carriage, each with four horses and twenty-four drivers.

units.zh: 次四望車、金根車，皆駕牛三，駕士各十二人。
units.en: Next came the Four-Directions carriage and Golden Root carriage, each drawn by three oxen with twelve drivers.
units.literal: Next, the Four-Directions carriage and Golden Root carriage, each drawn by three oxen with twelve drivers.

units.zh: 服同前。
units.en: Their dress matched that described above.
units.literal: Dress as before.

units.zh: 次左右廂牙門各二，每門執二人，夾四人。
units.en: Next came left and right wing gate banners, two each, with two bearers and four flankers per gate.
units.literal: Next, left and right wing gate banners, two each; per gate two bearers and four flankers.

units.zh: 並赤綦襖、黃袍、帽。
units.en: They all wore red patterned jackets, yellow robes, and caps.
units.literal: All wore red patterned jackets, yellow robes, and caps.

units.zh: 第一門在前黃麾前，第二門在後黃麾後。
units.en: The first gate stood before the front yellow banner; the second behind the rear yellow banner.
units.literal: The first gate was before the front yellow banner; the second gate was behind the rear yellow banner.

units.zh: 次左右領軍衛，每廂各一百五十人，執殳，並赤地黃花綦襖、帽、行縢、鞋襪。
units.en: Next came the Left and Right Army Supervisory Guards, each wing with one hundred fifty men bearing shu, all in red-ground yellow-flower patterned jackets, caps, leggings, shoes, and stockings.
units.literal: Next, the Left and Right Army Supervisory Guards; each wing 150 men bearing shu, all in red-ground yellow-flower patterned jackets, caps, leggings, shoes, and stockings.

units.zh: 前與黃麾仗齊，後盡鹵簿。
units.en: In front they aligned with the yellow-banner guard; in the rear they extended to the end of the guard of honor.
units.literal: In front they aligned with the yellow-banner armed guard; in the rear they extended to the end of the guard of honor.

units.zh: 廂各主帥四人，檢校。
units.en: Each wing had four troop-leading officers to inspect the formation.
units.literal: Each wing had four troop-leading officers to inspect.

units.zh: 平巾幘、緋衫、大口袴、被黃袍帽，執鍮石長刀，騎。
units.en: They wore flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet shirts, baggy trousers, yellow robes and caps, bore long blades with bronze-stone fittings, and rode.
units.literal: Flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet shirts, baggy trousers, wearing yellow robes and caps, bearing long blades with bronze-stone fittings, riding.

units.zh: 其服豹文者二在內，服獅文者二，一引前，一護後。
units.en: Two wore leopard pattern within the formation; two wore lion pattern—one leading in front and one guarding the rear.
units.literal: Of these, two in leopard pattern were within, and two in lion pattern—one leading in front and one guarding the rear.

units.zh: 次左右領軍衛、折沖都尉各一人，檢校殳仗。
units.en: Next came one assault-resistance commandant each from the Left and Right Army Supervisory Guards to inspect the shu guard.
units.literal: Next, one assault-resistance commandant each from the Left and Right Army Supervisory Guards to inspect the shu armed guard.

units.zh: 以上各一人騎從。
units.en: Each of the above had one mounted attendant.
units.literal: Each of the above had one mounted attendant.

units.zh: 次後殳仗內正道置牙門一，每門監門校尉二人，皆平巾幘、緋裲襠、大口袴，執銀裝長刀，騎。
units.en: Next, within the rear shu guard on the central route stood one gate banner; per gate two gate-keeping commandants in flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet cross-strap jackets, and baggy trousers bore silver-fitted long blades and rode.
units.literal: Next, within the rear shu armed guard on the central route one gate banner was placed; per gate two gate-keeping commandants, all with flat-cap kerchiefs, scarlet cross-strap jackets, baggy trousers, bearing silver-fitted long blades, riding.

units.zh: 每廂各巡檢校尉一人、往來檢校。
units.en: Each wing had one patrolling inspection commandant who went back and forth to inspect.
units.literal: Each wing had one patrolling inspection commandant going back and forth to inspect.

units.zh: 服仗同前。
units.en: Their dress and equipment matched those described above.
units.literal: Dress and equipment as before.

units.zh: 前後部鼓吹，金鉦、掆鼓、大鼓、長鳴、中鳴、鐃吹、羽葆、鼓吹、橫吹、節鼓、禦馬並減大駕之半。
units.en: The front and rear bands, golden chimes, shoulder drums, great drums, long calls, mid calls, cymbal-blow, feathered canopy, wind instruments, transverse wind, rhythm drums, and imperial horses were all reduced to half the grand carriage complement.
units.literal: Front and rear bands, golden chimes, shoulder drums, great drums, long calls, mid calls, cymbal-blow, feathered canopy, wind instruments, transverse wind, rhythm drums, and imperial horses were all reduced to half those of the grand carriage guard.

units.zh: 是歲，重翟等六車改用圓方輅輦，及行障、坐障、錦六柱、宮人等車，其制度人數並見《輿服志》。
units.en: That year, the six carriages including the Heavy Pheasant were changed to round-and-square carriage palanquins, along with marching screens, seated screens, brocade six-pillar screens, and palace women's carriages; their regulations and personnel counts are recorded in the Treatise on Carriages and Clothing.
units.literal: That year, the six carriages including the Heavy Pheasant were changed to use round-and-square carriage palanquins, as well as marching screens, seated screens, brocade six-pillar screens, palace women's carriages, and the like; their regulations and personnel counts are all recorded in the Treatise on Carriages and Clothing.

units.zh: 天德二年，海陵立後，皇后乘龍飾肩輿，有司設二步障於殿之西階，設扇左右各十，傘一，此蓋殿庭導引之儀也。
units.en: In Tiande 2 (1150), when Emperor Hailing installed the empress, she rode a dragon-decorated shoulder palanquin; the relevant offices set two walking screens at the hall's western steps, ten fans on each side, and one umbrella—this was the hall-court escort ritual.
units.literal: In the second year of Tiande, when Hailing installed the empress, the empress rode a dragon-decorated shoulder palanquin; the relevant offices set two walking screens at the western steps of the hall, ten fans left and right, and one umbrella—this was the hall-court escort ritual.

units.zh: 又設皇太后導從六十人，傘子不在數內，並服簇四盤雕團花紅錦襖、金花襆頭、塗金銀束帶。
units.en: They also set sixty escorts for the empress dowager, umbrella bearers not included in the count; all wore clustered four-plate carved round-flower red brocade jackets, golden-flower wrapped headcloths, and gilded silver belts.
units.literal: They also set sixty escorts for the empress dowager, umbrella bearers not counted within the number; all wore clustered four-plate carved round-flower red brocade jackets, golden-flower wrapped headcloths, and gilded silver belts.

units.zh: 永壽、永甯宮導駕各三十人，傘子各二人，此亦常行之儀也。
units.en: The Eternal Longevity and Eternal Tranquility palaces each had thirty imperial escorts and two umbrella bearers—part of the regular processional ritual.
units.literal: Eternal Longevity and Eternal Tranquility palaces each had thirty imperial escorts and two umbrella bearers; this too was the regular processional ritual.

units.zh: 皇太子鹵簿
units.en: Crown Prince Guard of Honor
units.literal: Crown prince guard of honor

units.zh: 受冊寶謝廟，凡大禮、大朝會則用之。
units.en: It was used when receiving the seal and treasure and offering thanks at the temple, and at all major rites and grand court assemblies.
units.literal: For receiving the seal and treasure and thanking at the temple, and for all great rites and great court assemblies, it was used.

units.zh: 有司奏當用唐、宋儀禮，詔止用千人。
units.en: The relevant offices memorialized that Tang and Song ritual should be followed; an edict limited the guard to one thousand men.
units.literal: The relevant offices memorialized that Tang and Song ritual should be used; an edict limited it to one thousand men.

units.zh: 中道。
units.en: Central route.
units.literal: Central route.

units.zh: 清遊隊二十四人：折沖都尉一人，白澤旗一，五人，弩四、弓六、槊八。
units.en: Clear Procession company: twenty-four men, including one assault-resistance commandant, one White Ze banner of five men, four crossbows, six bows, and eight spears.
units.literal: Clear Procession company, 24 men: one assault-resistance commandant, one White Ze banner with five men, four crossbows, six bows, and eight spears.

units.zh: 並騎。
units.en: They all rode.
units.literal: All rode.

units.zh: 清道直蕩隊一十八人：折沖都尉二人，皞槊四，弓矢十二。
units.en: Clear Road Direct Sweep company: eighteen men, with two assault-resistance commandants, four bright spears, and twelve bow-and-arrow sets.
units.literal: Clear Road Direct Sweep company, 18 men: two assault-resistance commandants, four bright spears, and twelve bow-and-arrow sets.

units.zh: 並騎。
units.en: They all rode.
units.literal: All rode.

units.zh: 誕馬四，控攏八人。
units.en: Four presentation horses with eight handlers.
units.literal: Four presentation horses and eight handlers.

units.zh: 正直旗隊三十三人：果毅都尉一人，重輪旗一、馴犀旗二、野馬旗一，馴象旗二，旗各五人，副竿二。
units.en: Upright Banner company: thirty-three men, including one resolute commandant; one Double Wheel banner, two Tamed Rhinoceros banners, one Wild Horse banner, and two Tamed Elephant banners of five men each, plus two secondary poles.
units.literal: Upright Banner company, 33 men: one resolute commandant; one Double Wheel banner, two Tamed Rhinoceros banners, one Wild Horse banner, and two Tamed Elephant banners, five men per banner, and two secondary poles.

units.zh: 並騎。
units.en: They all rode.
units.literal: All rode.

units.zh: 細引隊一十四人：果毅都尉二人，弓矢六，槊六。
units.en: Fine Lead company: fourteen men, with two resolute commandants, six bow-and-arrow sets, and six spears.
units.literal: Fine Lead company, 14 men: two resolute commandants, six bow-and-arrow sets, and six spears.

units.zh: 槊與弓矢相間，並騎。
units.en: Spears and bow-and-arrow sets alternated; they all rode.
units.literal: Spears and bow-and-arrow sets alternated; all rode.

units.zh: 前部鼓吹九十八人：並騎。
units.en: Front band: ninety-eight men, all mounted.
units.literal: Front band, 98 men; all rode.

units.zh: 府史二人，金鉦、掆鼓各二，大鼓十二，長鳴八，鐃鼓二，簫六，笳六、帥兵官二、節鼓二、小鼓十二、中鳴八、桃皮篳篥四、歌四、拱辰管六、篳篥六、大橫吹十二、羽葆鼓二、帥兵官二。
units.en: The band included two office clerks; two golden chimes and two shoulder drums each; twelve great drums; eight long calls; two cymbal-drums; six xiao flutes; six horns; two troop-leading officers; two rhythm drums; twelve small drums; eight mid calls; four peach-skin pipes; four singers; six Arch-the-Pole pipes; six pipes; twelve great transverse winds; two feathered-canopy drums; and two troop-leading officers.
units.literal: Two office clerks; two golden chimes and two shoulder drums each; twelve great drums; eight long calls; two cymbal-drums; six xiao flutes; six horns; two troop-leading officers; two rhythm drums; twelve small drums; eight mid calls; four peach-skin pipes; four singers; six Arch-the-Pole pipes; six pipes; twelve great transverse winds; two feathered-canopy drums; and two troop-leading officers.

units.zh: 傘扇八：梅紅傘二，大雉扇四，中雉扇二。
units.en: Eight umbrellas and fans: two plum-red umbrellas, four great pheasant-tail fans, and two medium pheasant-tail fans.
units.literal: Eight umbrellas and fans: two plum-red umbrellas, four great pheasant-tail fans, and two medium pheasant-tail fans.

units.zh: 小輿一十八人。
units.en: Small palanquin: eighteen men.
units.literal: Small palanquin, 18 men.

units.zh: 導引官一十二人：中允二人，諭德二人、庶子二人、詹事二人、太師一人、太傅一人、太保一人，少師一人在金輅後。
units.en: Twelve guide officers: two palace secretaries, two moral instructors, two shuzi, two supervisors of the household, one grand preceptor, one grand tutor, one grand protector, and one junior preceptor behind the golden carriage.
units.literal: Twelve guide officers: two palace secretaries, two moral instructors, two shuzi, two supervisors of the household, one grand preceptor, one grand tutor, one grand protector, and one junior preceptor behind the golden carriage.

units.zh: 並騎。
units.en: They all rode.
units.literal: All rode.

units.zh: 親勳翊衛圍子隊七十四人：郎將二人。
units.en: Personal Merit Flanking Guard encirclement company: seventy-four men, including two brigade generals.
units.literal: Personal Merit Flanking Guard encirclement company, 74 men: two brigade generals.

units.zh: 儀刀七十二。
units.en: Seventy-two ceremonial blades.
units.literal: Seventy-two ceremonial blades.

units.zh: 並騎。
units.en: They all rode.
units.literal: All rode.

units.zh: 金輅七十人。
units.en: Golden carriage: seventy men.
units.literal: Golden carriage, 70 men.

units.zh: 三衛隊一十八人。
units.en: Three Guards company: eighteen men.
units.literal: Three Guards company, 18 men.

units.zh: 執儀刀。
units.en: They bore ceremonial blades.
units.literal: Bearing ceremonial blades.

units.zh: 厭角隊六十二人：郎將一人，祥雲旗一，五人，弩三，弓七，稍十五，並騎。
units.en: Subdued Corner company: sixty-two men, including one brigade general, one Auspicious Cloud banner of five men, three crossbows, seven bows, and fifteen spears; all mounted.
units.literal: Subdued Corner company, 62 men: one brigade general, one Auspicious Cloud banner with five men, three crossbows, seven bows, and fifteen spears; all rode.

units.zh: 又郎將一人，祥雲旗一，五人，弩三，弓七，槊十五。
units.en: Also one brigade general, one Auspicious Cloud banner of five men, three crossbows, seven bows, and fifteen spears.
units.literal: Also one brigade general, one Auspicious Cloud banner with five men, three crossbows, seven bows, and fifteen spears.

units.zh: 並騎。
units.en: They all rode.
units.literal: All rode.

units.zh: 硃團扇一十六人：司禦率府校尉四人，騎。
units.en: Sixteen vermilion round fans, borne by four commandants of the Imperial Carriage Rate Office on horseback.
units.literal: Sixteen vermilion round fans: four commandants of the Imperial Carriage Rate Office, riding.

units.zh: 硃團扇三，紫曲蓋三，硃團扇三，紫曲蓋三。
units.en: Three vermilion round fans, three purple curved canopies, three vermilion round fans, and three purple curved canopies.
units.literal: Three vermilion round fans, three purple curved canopies, three vermilion round fans, and three purple curved canopies.

units.zh: 大角一十八。
units.en: Eighteen great horns.
units.literal: Eighteen great horns.

units.zh: 後部鼓吹五十四人：並騎。
units.en: Rear band: fifty-four men, all mounted.
units.literal: Rear band, 54 men; all rode.

units.zh: 管轄指揮一人，金鉦、掆鼓各一，鐃鼓二，簫六，歌六，篳篥六，節鼓一，主帥二人，笛六，笳四，拱辰管六，小橫吹十，主帥二人。
units.en: The rear band had one section commander; one golden chime and one shoulder drum each; two cymbal-drums; six xiao flutes; six singers; six pipes; one rhythm drum; two chief officers; six flutes; four horns; six Arch-the-Pole pipes; ten small transverse winds; and two chief officers.
units.literal: One section commander; one golden chime and one shoulder drum each; two cymbal-drums; six xiao flutes; six singers; six pipes; one rhythm drum; two chief officers; six flutes; four horns; six Arch-the-Pole pipes; ten small transverse winds; and two chief officers.

units.zh: 後拒隊四十六人：果毅都尉一人，騎。
units.en: Rear Blocking company: forty-six men, led by one resolute commandant on horseback.
units.literal: Rear Blocking company, 46 men: one resolute commandant, riding.

units.zh: 三角獸旗一，五人，弩四，弓矢十六，槊二十。
units.en: One Triangular Beast banner of five men, with four crossbows, sixteen bow-and-arrow sets, and twenty spears.
units.literal: One Triangular Beast banner with five men, four crossbows, sixteen bow-and-arrow sets, and twenty spears.

units.zh: 外仗。
units.en: Outer armed guard.
units.literal: Outer armed guard.

units.zh: 左行二百四人。
units.en: Left column: two hundred four men.
units.literal: Left column, 204 men.

units.zh: 牙門十六人：並騎。
units.en: Gate banners: sixteen men, all mounted.
units.literal: Gate banners, 16 men; all rode.

units.zh: 牙門旗一，三人，監門校尉三人，郎將一人，班劍九。
units.en: One gate banner with three men, three gate-keeping commandants, one brigade general, and nine court swords.
units.literal: One gate banner with three men, three gate-keeping commandants, one brigade general, and nine court swords.

units.zh: 前第一隊二十七人：司禦率府一人，果毅都尉一人，折沖都尉一人，主帥一人，並騎。
units.en: Front first company: twenty-seven men, including one Imperial Carriage Rate Office officer, one resolute commandant, one assault-resistance commandant, and one chief officer, all mounted.
units.literal: Front first company, 27 men: one Imperial Carriage Rate Office officer, one resolute commandant, one assault-resistance commandant, and one chief officer; all rode.

units.zh: 絳引幡三首，九人，麟頭竿二，儀鍠斧二，弓矢二，麟頭竿二，儀鍠斧二，硃刀盾二，小戟二。
units.en: Three scarlet lead banners with nine men; two qilin-head poles, two ceremonial axes, two bow-and-arrow sets, two more qilin-head poles, two ceremonial axes, two vermilion blade-shields, and two small halberds.
units.literal: Three scarlet lead banners, nine men; two qilin-head poles, two ceremonial axes, two bow-and-arrow sets, two qilin-head poles, two ceremonial axes, two vermilion blade-shields, and two small halberds.

units.zh: 第二、第三、第四、第五隊各一十四人。
units.en: The second, third, fourth, and fifth companies had fourteen men each.
units.literal: Second, third, fourth, and fifth companies, 14 men each.

units.zh: 與第一部麟頭竿已下同。
units.en: From the qilin-head poles onward, the equipment matched the first company.
units.literal: From the qilin-head poles onward, the same as the first company.

units.zh: 後第一隊四十七人：牙門旗一，三人，監門校尉三人，果毅都尉一人，主帥一人，絳引幡三，九人，鶡雞旗一，五人，槊四，弩三，槊四，弓矢三，槊四，弓矢三，硃刀盾二，小戟二。
units.en: Rear first company: forty-seven men, including one gate banner with three men, three gate-keeping commandants, one resolute commandant, one chief officer, three scarlet lead banners with nine men, one Sparrow-Hawk banner with five men, alternating spears, crossbows, and bow-and-arrow sets, two vermilion blade-shields, and two small halberds.
units.literal: Rear first company, 47 men: one gate banner with three men, three gate-keeping commandants, one resolute commandant, one chief officer, three scarlet lead banners with nine men, one Sparrow-Hawk banner with five men, four spears, three crossbows, four spears, three bow-and-arrow sets, four spears, three bow-and-arrow sets, two vermilion blade-shields, and two small halberds.

units.zh: 並騎。
units.en: They all rode.
units.literal: All rode.

units.zh: 後第二隊二十九人：果毅都尉一人，綱子旗一，五人，槊五，弩三，槊五，弓矢三，槊三，弓矢四。
units.en: Rear second company: twenty-nine men, with one resolute commandant, one Net banner of five men, and alternating spears, crossbows, and bow-and-arrow sets.
units.literal: Rear second company, 29 men: one resolute commandant, one Net banner with five men, five spears, three crossbows, five spears, three bow-and-arrow sets, three spears, and four bow-and-arrow sets.

units.zh: 並騎。
units.en: They all rode.
units.literal: All rode.

units.zh: 後第三隊二十九人：果毅都尉一人，黃鹿旗一，五人，槊五，弩三，槊五，弓矢三，槊三，弓矢四。
units.en: Rear third company: twenty-nine men, with one resolute commandant, one Yellow Deer banner of five men, and alternating spears, crossbows, and bow-and-arrow sets.
units.literal: Rear third company, 29 men: one resolute commandant, one Yellow Deer banner with five men, five spears, three crossbows, five spears, three bow-and-arrow sets, three spears, and four bow-and-arrow sets.

units.zh: 並騎。
units.en: They all rode.
units.literal: All rode.

units.zh: 右行二百四人，排列同。
units.en: Right column: two hundred four men, arranged identically.
units.literal: Right column, 204 men, arranged the same.

units.zh: 太子常行儀衛，導從六十二人，傘子二人，並服梅紅繡羅雙盤鳳襖、金花襆頭、塗金銀束帶。
units.en: For the crown prince's regular processional guard, sixty-two guides and attendants and two umbrella bearers all wore plum-red embroidered silk double-disk phoenix jackets, golden-flower wrapped headcloths, and gilded silver belts.
units.literal: For the crown prince's regular processional ceremonial escort, sixty-two guides and attendants and two umbrella bearers, all wearing plum-red embroidered silk double-disk phoenix jackets, golden-flower wrapped headcloths, and gilded silver belts.

units.zh: 凡從物鏾鑼、唾盂、水罐等事並用銀金飾。
units.en: All follow-items such as clappers, spittoons, and water jars were decorated with silver and gold.
units.literal: All follow-items such as clappers, spittoons, and water jars were decorated with silver and gold.

units.zh: 傘用梅紅羅、坐麒麟金浮圖。
units.en: Umbrellas were of plum-red silk with seated-qilin golden finials.
units.literal: Umbrellas used plum-red silk and seated qilin golden finials.

units.zh: 椅用金鍍銀圈、雙戲麒麟椅背，紅絨絛結。
units.en: Chairs had gold-plated silver rings, double-playing-qilin chair backs, and red velvet cord ties.
units.literal: Chairs used gold-plated silver rings, double-playing-qilin chair backs, and red velvet cord ties.

units.zh: 殿庭與宴，𧝋用繡羅間金盤鳳，卓衣則用繡羅獨角間金盤獸。
units.en: For hall court and banquets, seat cushions used embroidered silk with gold phoenix disks; table covers used embroidered silk with gold unicorn-and-beast disks.
units.literal: For hall court and banquets, cushions used embroidered silk with gold phoenix disks; table covers used embroidered silk with gold unicorn-and-beast disks.

units.zh: 東宮視事，硃髹飾椅，塗金銀獸銜、紅絨絛結，明金團花椅背，案衣則用素羅，色皆梅紅，蒙帕踏腳同。
units.en: When conducting affairs in the Eastern Palace, chairs were vermilion-lacquered with gilded silver beast mouthpieces, red velvet cord ties, and bright-gold floral chair backs; desk covers were plain plum-red silk, with matching cover cloths and footrests.
units.literal: When conducting affairs in the Eastern Palace, vermilion-lacquered chairs, gilded silver beast mouthpieces, red velvet cord ties, bright-gold floral chair backs; desk covers used plain silk, all plum-red in color, with cover cloths and footrests matching.

units.zh: 親王傔從
units.en: Princely Attendants
units.literal: Princely attendants

units.zh: 引接十人，皁衫、盤裹、束帶、乘馬。
units.en: Ten reception escorts in black shirts, wrapped sashes, and belts, mounted on horseback.
units.literal: Ten reception escorts, black shirts, wrapped sashes, belts, riding horses.

units.zh: 牽攏官五十人，首領紫羅襖、素襆頭，執銀裹牙杖，傘子紫羅團荅繡芙蓉襖、間金花交腳襆頭，余人紫羅四䙆繡芙蓉襖、兩邊黃絹義襴，並用金鍍銀束帶，襆頭同。
units.en: Fifty carriage-handlers: leaders in purple silk jackets and plain wrapped headcloths bore silver-wrapped ivory staffs; umbrella bearers wore purple silk round hibiscus-embroidered jackets and gold-flower crossed-foot headcloths; the rest wore purple silk four-panel hibiscus-embroidered jackets with yellow silk side panels, all with gold-plated silver belts and matching headcloths.
units.literal: Fifty carriage-handlers; leaders in purple silk jackets and plain wrapped headcloths, bearing silver-wrapped ivory staffs; umbrella bearers in purple silk round hibiscus-embroidered jackets and gold-flower crossed-foot headcloths; the rest in purple silk four-panel hibiscus-embroidered jackets with yellow silk side panels, all with gold-plated silver belts and matching headcloths.

units.zh: 邀喝四人。
units.en: Four invitation criers.
units.literal: Four invitation criers.

units.zh: 傘用青表紫裏，金鍍銀浮圖。
units.en: Umbrellas were blue outside and purple inside, with gold-plated silver finials.
units.literal: Umbrellas used blue outside and purple lining, with gold-plated silver finials.

units.zh: 椅用銀裹圈背。
units.en: Chairs had silver-wrapped ring backs.
units.literal: Chairs used silver-wrapped ring backs.

units.zh: 水罐、鏾鑼、唾盂並用銀。
units.en: Water jars, clappers, and spittoons were all of silver.
units.literal: Water jars, clappers, and spittoons were all of silver.

units.zh: 郡王牽攏官三十人，未出宮者二十人。
units.en: Princes of a commandery had thirty carriage-handlers; those not yet leaving the palace had twenty.
units.literal: Princes of a commandery had thirty carriage-handlers; those not yet leaving the palace had twenty.

units.zh: 國公牽攏官二十人，未出宮者十四人。
units.en: State dukes had twenty carriage-handlers; those not yet leaving the palace had fourteen.
units.literal: State dukes had twenty carriage-handlers; those not yet leaving the palace had fourteen.

units.zh: 郡王引接六人，國公四人，未出宮者各減半。
units.en: Princes of a commandery had six reception escorts and state dukes four; those not yet leaving the palace had half that number.
units.literal: Princes of a commandery had six reception escorts, state dukes four; those not yet leaving the palace had half each.

units.zh: 人從儀物並依一品職事官制。
units.en: Personnel, attendants, and ceremonial objects all followed the regulations for first-rank functional officials.
units.literal: Personnel, attendants, and ceremonial objects all followed the regulations for first-rank functional officials.

units.zh: 諸妃嬪導從
units.en: Guides and Attendants for Imperial Consorts
units.literal: Guides and attendants for all imperial consorts

units.zh: 四十人，襆頭、繡盤蕉紫衫、塗金束帶。
units.en: Forty men wore wrapped headcloths, embroidered plantain-disk purple shirts, and gilded belts.
units.literal: Forty men, wrapped headcloths, embroidered plantain-disk purple shirts, and gilded belts.

units.zh: 妃用偏扇、方扇、團扇各十六，諸嬪各十四，皆宮人執，服雲腳紗帽、紫四䙆衫、束帶、綠靴。
units.en: Consorts had sixteen each of side, square, and round fans; imperial concubines fourteen each—all borne by palace women in cloud-foot gauze caps, purple four-panel shirts, belts, and green boots.
units.literal: Consorts used sixteen each of side fans, square fans, and round fans; all imperial concubines fourteen each; all borne by palace women, wearing cloud-foot gauze caps, purple four-panel shirts, belts, and green boots.

units.zh: 大傘各一，傘子二人，就用本服錦襖襆帶。
units.en: Each had one great umbrella and two umbrella bearers in their regular-service brocade jackets and headcloths.
units.literal: One great umbrella each, two umbrella bearers, using their regular-service brocade jackets and headcloths.

units.zh: 大長公主導從一十二人，皇妹皇女一十人，並服紫羅繡胸背葵花夾襖、盤裹、襆頭、大佩銀腰帶，牙杖各二。
units.en: Grand imperial princesses had twelve guides and attendants; imperial younger sisters and daughters ten—all in purple silk chest-and-back sunflower jackets, wrapped sashes, headcloths, large silver waist belts, and two ivory staffs each.
units.literal: Grand imperial princesses had twelve guides and attendants; imperial younger sisters and daughters ten; all wore purple silk chest-and-back sunflower jackets, wrapped sashes, headcloths, large silver waist belts, and two ivory staffs each.

units.zh: 其諸宗室女，各以親疏差降之。
units.en: For other imperial clan women, numbers were reduced according to closeness of kinship.
units.literal: For all other imperial clan women, each was reduced according to closeness of kinship.

units.zh: 傘制，皇太子三位妃皆青羅表紫裏、金浮圖，親王公主王妃金鍍銀浮圖、郡主縣主夫人銀浮圖，皆青表紫裏，諸臣下母妻各從其夫子勳封品級用傘。
units.en: Umbrella regulations: the crown prince's three consorts used blue silk outside and purple inside with golden finials; princes, princesses, and princely consorts used gold-plated silver finials; commandery and county princesses and their ladies used silver finials, all blue outside and purple inside; officials' mothers and wives used umbrellas according to their husbands' ranks of merit and enfeoffment.
units.literal: Umbrella regulations: all three consorts of the crown prince used blue silk outside and purple inside with golden finials; princes, princesses, and princely consorts used gold-plated silver finials; commandery and county princesses and their ladies used silver finials, all blue outside and purple inside; mothers and wives of officials each used umbrellas according to their husbands' ranks of merit and enfeoffment.

units.zh: 百官儀從
units.en: Ceremonial Attendants for Officials
units.literal: Ceremonial attendants for all officials

units.zh: 正一品：三師、三公、尚書令，硃衣直省各十人，三公稱直府。
units.en: First positive rank: the Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, and Grand Protector; the Three Dukes; and the Director of the Department of State Affairs—each with ten vermilion-robed direct attendants; the Three Dukes' attendants were called Direct Office.
units.literal: First rank, positive: Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, and Grand Protector; Three Dukes; Director of the Department of State Affairs—ten vermilion-robed direct attendants each; the Three Dukes' attendants were called Direct Office.

units.zh: 牽攏官各六十人，並服紫衫帽、銀偏帶，內執藤棒二對、骨朵三對，牙杖三對，簇馬六人，傘子二人。
units.en: Each had sixty carriage-handlers in purple shirts and caps with silver side belts, including two pairs of rattan staffs, three pairs of maces, three pairs of ivory staffs, six clustered-horse attendants, and two umbrella bearers.
units.literal: Sixty carriage-handlers each, all in purple shirts and caps with silver side belts; including two pairs of rattan staffs, three pairs of maces, three pairs of ivory staffs, six clustered-horse attendants, and two umbrella bearers.

units.zh: 交椅、水罐、鏾鑼、盂子、唾碗等事以次執之，服皁衫帽、塗金銅束帶。
units.en: Folding chairs, water jars, clappers, bowls, spittoons, and the like were borne in sequence by attendants in black shirts and caps with gilded copper belts.
units.literal: Folding chairs, water jars, clappers, bowls, spittoons, and the like were borne in sequence, wearing black shirts and caps with gilded copper belts.

units.zh: 後凡執色人並同。
units.en: Thereafter all equipment-bearing attendants followed the same rule.
units.literal: Thereafter all color-bearing attendants were the same.

units.zh: 邀喝四人。
units.en: Four invitation criers.
units.literal: Four invitation criers.

units.zh: 傘用青羅紫裏、銀浮圖。
units.en: Umbrellas were blue silk with purple lining and silver finials.
units.literal: Umbrellas used blue silk with purple lining and silver finials.

units.zh: 從一品：尚書左右丞相、平章政事、都元帥、樞密使，直省同，樞密稱直院，以班祗人充。
units.en: First negative rank: the Left and Right Chancellors, Managers of Governmental Affairs, Commander-in-Chief, and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs—with the same direct attendants; the Bureau called them Direct Court, filled by duty attendants.
units.literal: First rank, negative: Left and Right Chancellors of the Department of State Affairs, Managers of Governmental Affairs, Commander-in-Chief, and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs—direct attendants the same; the Bureau of Military Affairs called them Direct Court, filled by attendants on duty.

units.zh: 牽攏官五十人，邀喝四人。
units.en: Fifty carriage-handlers and four invitation criers.
units.literal: Fifty carriage-handlers and four invitation criers.

units.zh: 判大宗正，引接十人、牽攏官四十人。
units.en: Administrator of the Imperial Clan Court: ten reception escorts and forty carriage-handlers.
units.literal: Administrator of the Imperial Clan Court: ten reception escorts and forty carriage-handlers.

units.zh: 大興尹，面前兩對，餘並同。
units.en: Magistrate of Daxing: two pairs before him; the rest matched the above.
units.literal: Magistrate of Daxing: two pairs before him; the rest the same.

units.zh: 以上交椅並用銀裹圈背、紫絲滌結。
units.en: For all the above, folding chairs had silver-wrapped ring backs and purple silk cord ties.
units.literal: For all the above, folding chairs used silver-wrapped ring backs and purple silk cord ties.

units.zh: 正二品：東宮三師、左右副元帥。
units.en: Second positive rank: the Eastern Palace Three Excellencies and the Left and Right Vice Commanders-in-Chief.
units.literal: Second rank, positive: Eastern Palace Three Excellencies and Left and Right Vice Commanders-in-Chief.

units.zh: 尚書左右丞，直省八人，牽攏官四十人，邀喝三人，傘用硃浮圖。
units.en: Left and Right Vice Directors: eight direct attendants, forty carriage-handlers, three invitation criers; umbrellas had vermilion finials.
units.literal: Left and Right Vice Directors of the Department of State Affairs: eight direct attendants, forty carriage-handlers, three invitation criers; umbrellas used vermilion finials.

units.zh: 從二品：參知政事、樞密副使、御史大夫，直省同，禦史台稱通引，以皞使班祗人充。
units.en: Second negative rank: Participant in Governance, Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs, and Censor-in-Chief—with the same direct attendants; the Censorate called them General Escorts, filled by duty attendants.
units.literal: Second rank, negative: Participant in Governance, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Censor-in-Chief—direct attendants the same; the Censorate called them General Escorts, filled by bright-attendant duty officers.

units.zh: 牽攏三十六人，邀喝數同。
units.en: Thirty-six carriage-handlers; the same number of invitation criers.
units.literal: Thirty-six carriage-handlers; invitation criers the same number.

units.zh: 正三品：東宮三少、元帥左右監軍、殿前都點檢、六部尚書、諸京留守、宣徽、勸農使、翰林學士承旨等官，凡同品者，各引接六人，牽攏官二十人。
units.en: Third positive rank: the Eastern Palace Three Juniors, Army Supervisors of the Commander-in-Chief, Chief Palace Inspector, Ministers of the Six Ministries, capital guardians, Palace Proclamation Commissioner, Commissioner for Encouraging Agriculture, Hanlin Academician Recipient of Edicts, and equivalent offices—each with six reception escorts and twenty carriage-handlers.
units.literal: Third rank, positive: Eastern Palace Three Juniors, Left and Right Army Supervisors of the Commander-in-Chief, Chief Palace Inspector, Ministers of the Six Ministries, capital guardians, Palace Proclamation Commissioner, Commissioner for Encouraging Agriculture, Hanlin Academician Recipient of Edicts, and all offices of the same rank—each six reception escorts and twenty carriage-handlers.

units.zh: 以上交椅並用直背銀間妝、青絲滌結。
units.en: For all the above, folding chairs had straight backs with silver inlay and blue silk cord ties.
units.literal: For all the above, folding chairs used straight backs with silver inlay and blue silk cord ties.

units.zh: 諸京都轉運使、招討使、諸路提刑使、諸府尹兼本路兵馬都總管及留守，牽攏官五十人。
units.en: Transport commissioners of all capitals, pacification commissioners, circuit chief judicial commissioners, and prefects concurrently serving as circuit military commanders-in-chief and guardians—each had fifty carriage-handlers.
units.literal: Transport commissioners of all capitals, pacification commissioners, circuit chief judicial commissioners, and prefects concurrently serving as circuit military commanders-in-chief and guardians—fifty carriage-handlers.

units.zh: 外任，統軍使、都運、招討使、副使、諸府尹兼總管，牽攏官五四十五人，公使七十人。
units.en: For external appointments: army supervisors, transport directors, pacification commissioners and vice commissioners, and prefects concurrently serving as commanders-in-chief—forty-five carriage-handlers and seventy public envoys.
units.literal: For external appointments: army supervisors, transport directors, pacification commissioners and vice commissioners, and prefects concurrently serving as commanders-in-chief—forty-five carriage-handlers and seventy public envoys.

units.zh: 從三品：元帥左右都監、勸農副使、殿前副都點檢及禦史中丞等官，凡同品者，各引接六人，牽攏官一十八人，內中丞引從則給緋衫。
units.en: Third negative rank: Chief Army Supervisors, Vice Commissioner for Encouraging Agriculture, Vice Chief Palace Inspector, Vice Censor-in-Chief, and equivalent offices—each with six reception escorts and eighteen carriage-handlers; the vice censor-in-chief's escort received scarlet shirts.
units.literal: Third rank, negative: Left and Right Chief Army Supervisors of the Commander-in-Chief, Vice Commissioner for Encouraging Agriculture, Vice Chief Palace Inspector, and Vice Censor-in-Chief, and all offices of the same rank—each six reception escorts and eighteen carriage-handlers; for the vice censor-in-chief's escort, scarlet shirts were issued.

units.zh: 外任，運使、節度使、牽攏官四十人，諸節鎮、諸部族節度同，公使上鎮七十人、中鎮六十五人、下鎮六十人。
units.en: For external appointments: transport commissioners and military governors had forty carriage-handlers; all circuit garrisons and tribal military governors the same; public envoys numbered seventy for upper garrisons, sixty-five for middle, and sixty for lower.
units.literal: For external appointments: transport commissioners and military governors—forty carriage-handlers; all circuit garrisons and tribal military governors the same; public envoys for upper garrisons seventy, middle garrisons sixty-five, lower garrisons sixty.

units.zh: 以上外任官人從服色，除諸招討、總管、部族節度、群牧使自來無射糧軍人力者並仍舊外，留守、統軍、總管、都運、招討、府尹、轉運、節度使人力亦仍舊，其數雖多，俱不得過四十人，並服紫衫、銀帶，銀裹圈背交椅、銀水罐、鏾鑼、盂、碗、牙杖，內銀裹骨朵、大劍各兩封，及邀喝，唯運使無骨朵、大劍。
units.en: For all external officials above: except pacification commissioners, commanders-in-chief, tribal military governors, and herd commissioners who had never had ration-funded military manpower and remained unchanged, guardians, army supervisors, commanders-in-chief, transport directors, pacification commissioners, prefects, transport commissioners, and military governors also retained their old complements; although numbers were large, none could exceed forty men. All wore purple shirts and silver belts, with silver-wrapped ring-back folding chairs, silver water jars, clappers, bowls, spittoons, and ivory staffs; each also had two sets of silver-wrapped maces and great swords and invitation criers—except transport commissioners, who had no maces or great swords.
units.literal: For all the above external officials' attendants and dress colors: except that pacification commissioners, commanders-in-chief, tribal military governors, and herd commissioners who from the beginning had no ration-funded military manpower remained as before, guardians, army supervisors, commanders-in-chief, transport directors, pacification commissioners, prefects, transport commissioners, and military governors also retained their old manpower; although the numbers were many, none could exceed forty men. All wore purple shirts and silver belts, silver-wrapped ring-back folding chairs, silver water jars, clappers, bowls, spittoons, and ivory staffs; within, silver-wrapped maces and great swords two sets each, and invitation criers—only transport commissioners had no maces or great swords.

units.zh: 正四品：左右諫議大夫、國子祭酒、六部侍郎等官，凡同品者，各引接八人，本破十二人。
units.en: Fourth positive rank: Left and Right Remonstrance Grandees, Director of the Directorate of Education, Vice Ministers of the Six Ministries, and equivalent offices—each with eight reception escorts and twelve personal attendants.
units.literal: Fourth rank, positive: Left and Right Remonstrance Grand Masters, Director of the Directorate of Education, Vice Ministers of the Six Ministries, and all offices of the same rank—each eight reception escorts and twelve personal attendants.

units.zh: 外任，留守同統軍都監、提刑副使，各牽攏官三十人。
units.en: For external appointments: guardians, army supervisory commanders, and vice chief judicial commissioners—each had thirty carriage-handlers.
units.literal: For external appointments: guardians, army supervisory commanders, and vice chief judicial commissioners—thirty carriage-handlers each.

units.zh: 從四品：殿前左右衛將軍、諸猛安千戶、親王府尉、諸京同知轉運等官，凡同品者，各引接四人，本破十二人。
units.en: Fourth negative rank: Left and Right Palace Guard Generals, all meng'an chiliarchs, princely mansion commandants, and capital transport vice commissioners, and equivalent offices—each with four reception escorts and twelve personal attendants.
units.literal: Fourth rank, negative: Left and Right Palace Guard Generals, all meng'an chiliarchs, princely mansion commandants, and capital transport vice commissioners, and all offices of the same rank—each four reception escorts and twelve personal attendants.

units.zh: 外任，牽攏官三十五人，公使上防禦六十人、中防禦五十五人、下防禦五十人。
units.en: For external appointments: thirty-five carriage-handlers; public envoys numbered sixty for upper defense commands, fifty-five for middle, and fifty for lower.
units.literal: For external appointments: thirty-five carriage-handlers; public envoys for upper defense commands sixty, middle defense commands fifty-five, lower defense commands fifty.

units.zh: 正五品：尚書左右司郎中、翰林待制、太常少卿等官，凡同品者，各本破八人。
units.en: Fifth positive rank: Left and Right Bureau Directors, Hanlin Attendant Draftsmen, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and equivalent offices—each with eight personal attendants.
units.literal: Fifth rank, positive: Left and Right Bureau Directors of the Department of State Affairs, Hanlin Attendant Draftsmen, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and all offices of the same rank—each eight personal attendants.

units.zh: 外任，牽攏官三十人，公使上州五十人、中州四十五人、下州四十人。
units.en: For external appointments: thirty carriage-handlers; public envoys numbered fifty for upper prefectures, forty-five for middle, and forty for lower.
units.literal: For external appointments: thirty carriage-handlers; public envoys for upper prefectures fifty, middle prefectures forty-five, lower prefectures forty.

units.zh: 凡防禦、刺史、知軍、並京府統軍司、節鎮佐貳官人從，並服紫衫、角束帶，直背銀交椅、鏾鑼、盂子、唾碗、牙杖，傘用青表 碧裏青浮圖。
units.en: Defense commissioners, prefects, military governors, capital army supervisory offices, and secondary circuit-garrison officials' attendants all wore purple shirts and horn belts, with straight-back silver folding chairs, clappers, bowls, spittoons, and ivory staffs; umbrellas were blue outside, green inside, with green finials.
units.literal: All defense commissioners, prefects, military governors, capital army supervisory offices, and secondary circuit-garrison officials' attendants wore purple shirts and horn belts, straight-back silver folding chairs, clappers, bowls, spittoons, and ivory staffs; umbrellas used blue outside, green inside, and green finials.

units.zh: 防禦、刺史、知軍仍用銀裹骨朵、大劍一對，邀喝，唯隨路副統軍則不邀喝。
units.en: Defense commissioners, prefects, and military governors still had silver-wrapped maces, a pair of great swords, and invitation criers—except circuit vice army supervisors, who had no criers.
units.literal: Defense commissioners, prefects, and military governors still used silver-wrapped maces and one pair of great swords, with invitation criers; only circuit vice army supervisors had no invitation criers.

units.zh: 從五品：六部郎中、侍御史、大理少卿等官，凡同品者，本破七人，侍禦引從則給緋衫。
units.en: Fifth negative rank: Directors of the Six Ministries, Attending Censors, Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review, and equivalent offices—seven personal attendants each; attending censor escorts received scarlet shirts.
