units.literal: Fifth rank, negative: Directors of the Six Ministries, Attending Censors, Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review, and all offices of the same rank—seven personal attendants each; attending censor escorts were issued scarlet shirts.

units.zh: 外任，本破十人。
units.en: For external appointments: ten personal attendants.
units.literal: For external appointments: ten personal attendants.

units.zh: 以上職事官並許張蓋。
units.en: All functional officials above were permitted canopy umbrellas.
units.literal: All functional officials above were permitted canopy umbrellas.

units.zh: 正六品：尚書左右司員外等官，凡同品者，本破六人。
units.en: Sixth positive rank: Left and Right Bureau Vice Directors and equivalent offices—six personal attendants each.
units.literal: Sixth rank, positive: Left and Right Bureau Vice Directors of the Department of State Affairs and all offices of the same rank—six personal attendants each.

units.zh: 外任，本破九人。
units.en: For external appointments: nine personal attendants.
units.literal: For external appointments: nine personal attendants.

units.zh: 從六品：尚書六部員外等官，凡同品者，本破五人。
units.en: Sixth negative rank: Vice Directors of the Six Ministries and equivalent offices—five personal attendants each.
units.literal: Sixth rank, negative: Vice Directors of the Six Ministries and all offices of the same rank—five personal attendants each.

units.zh: 外任，本破九人。
units.en: For external appointments: nine personal attendants.
units.literal: For external appointments: nine personal attendants.

units.zh: 正七品：殿中侍御史等官，凡同品者，本破四人。
units.en: Seventh positive rank: Palace Censors and equivalent offices—four personal attendants each.
units.literal: Seventh rank, positive: Palace Censors and all offices of the same rank—four personal attendants each.

units.zh: 外任，本破七人。
units.en: For external appointments: seven personal attendants.
units.literal: For external appointments: seven personal attendants.

units.zh: 縣令，公使十人。
units.en: County magistrates: ten public envoys.
units.literal: County magistrates: ten public envoys.

units.zh: 都軍，公使六人。
units.en: District commanders: six public envoys.
units.literal: District commanders: six public envoys.

units.zh: 從七品：應奉翰林文字等官，凡同品者，本破四人。
units.en: Seventh negative rank: Attendant Drafters of Hanlin Documents and equivalent offices—four personal attendants each.
units.literal: Seventh rank, negative: Attendant Drafters of Hanlin Documents and all offices of the same rank—four personal attendants each.

units.zh: 外任，本破六人。
units.en: For external appointments: six personal attendants.
units.literal: For external appointments: six personal attendants.

units.zh: 縣令，公使十人。
units.en: County magistrates: ten public envoys.
units.literal: County magistrates: ten public envoys.

units.zh: 正八品：大理評事等官，凡同品者，本破二人。
units.en: Eighth positive rank: Judicial Review Assessors and equivalent offices—two personal attendants each.
units.literal: Eighth rank, positive: Judicial Review Assessors and all offices of the same rank—two personal attendants each.

units.zh: 外任，本破六人。
units.en: For external appointments: six personal attendants.
units.literal: For external appointments: six personal attendants.

units.zh: 從八品：太常太祝等官，凡同品者，本破二人。
units.en: Eighth negative rank: Grand Sacrificers of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and equivalent offices—two personal attendants each.
units.literal: Eighth rank, negative: Grand Sacrificers of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and all offices of the same rank—two personal attendants each.

units.zh: 外任，本破五人。
units.en: For external appointments: five personal attendants.
units.literal: For external appointments: five personal attendants.

units.zh: 正九品：禦藥都監等官，凡同品者，本破一人。
units.en: Ninth positive rank: Chief Supervisors of Imperial Pharmacy and equivalent offices—one personal attendant each.
units.literal: Ninth rank, positive: Chief Supervisors of Imperial Pharmacy and all offices of the same rank—one personal attendant each.

units.zh: 外任，本破三人。
units.en: For external appointments: three personal attendants.
units.literal: For external appointments: three personal attendants.

units.zh: 從九品：隨殿位承應、同監等官，凡同品者，本破一人。
units.en: Ninth negative rank: Hall Attendants and Vice Supervisors and equivalent offices—one personal attendant each.
units.literal: Ninth rank, negative: Hall Attendants and Vice Supervisors and all offices of the same rank—one personal attendant each.

units.zh: 外任，本破一人。
units.en: For external appointments: one personal attendant.
units.literal: For external appointments: one personal attendant.

units.zh: 尚書省樞密院令譯史通事、六部禦史台及統軍司通事、誥院令史、國史院書寫等職，各設本破一人。
units.en: Clerks, translators, and interpreters of the Department of State Affairs and the Bureau of Military Affairs; interpreters of the Six Ministries, Censorate, and Army Supervisory Office; edict-office clerks; National History Institute copyists; and similar posts—each had one personal attendant.
units.literal: Translators and interpreters of the Department of State Affairs and Bureau of Military Affairs, interpreters of the Six Ministries, Censorate, and Army Supervisory Office, edict-office clerks, National History Institute copyists, and similar posts—each had one personal attendant.

units.zh: 以上職官，人力從物不得僭越。
units.en: For all offices above, manpower and ceremonial equipment could not exceed prescribed rank.
units.literal: For all offices above, manpower and follow-items could not exceed their rank.

units.zh: 其外任官，人從服執，以本處公用或贓罰錢置。
units.en: External officials' attendants, dress, and equipment were funded from local public funds or fines.
units.literal: For external officials, attendants, dress, and equipment were provided from local public funds or fines.

units.zh: 凡內外官自親王以下，傔從各有名數差等，而硃衣直省不與。
units.en: For all inner and outer officials from princes downward, attendants had fixed numbers graded by rank, but vermilion-robed direct attendants were excluded.
units.literal: For all inner and outer officials from princes downward, attendants each had fixed numbers and graded differences, but vermilion-robed direct attendants were not included.

units.zh: 其賤者，一曰引接亦曰引從，內宮從四品以上設之。
units.en: The lower grades were: first, reception escorts, also called guide escorts, for inner-court offices from fourth rank upward.
units.literal: Of the lower grades: first, reception escorts, also called guide escorts, established for inner-court offices from fourth rank upward.

units.zh: 二曰牽攏官，內外正五品以上設之。
units.en: Second, carriage-handlers, for inner and outer officials of fifth positive rank and above.
units.literal: Second, carriage-handlers, established for inner and outer officials of fifth positive rank and above.

units.zh: 三曰本破，內外正四品以下設之。
units.en: Third, personal attendants, for inner and outer officials of fourth positive rank and below.
units.literal: Third, personal attendants, established for inner and outer officials of fourth positive rank and below.

units.zh: 四曰公使，外官正三品以下設之。
units.en: Fourth, public envoys, for external officials of third positive rank and below.
units.literal: Fourth, public envoys, established for external officials of third positive rank and below.

units.zh: 五曰從己人力，外官正三品京都留守、大興府尹以下等官設之。
units.en: Fifth, personal manpower, for external officials of third positive rank, capital guardians, the magistrate of Daxing, and below.
units.literal: Fifth, personal manpower, established for external officials of third positive rank, capital guardians, magistrate of Daxing, and below.

units.zh: 本破如牽攏之職，公使從公家之事，從己執私家之役者也。
units.en: Personal attendants performed duties like carriage-handlers; public envoys handled public business; personal manpower performed private service.
units.literal: Personal attendants performed duties like carriage-handlers; public envoys followed public affairs; personal manpower performed private service.

units.zh: 五等皆以射糧軍充，其軍非驗物力以事攻討，特招募民年十七以上、三十以下魁偉壯健者收刺，以資糧給之，故曰射糧。
units.en: All five grades were filled by ration-archer troops. These were not property-levied campaign soldiers but civilians aged seventeen to thirty, tall and strong, specially recruited, registered, and paid provisions—hence ration-archers.
units.literal: All five grades were filled by ration-archer troops; these troops were not levied by verifying property for campaigns, but specially recruited from civilians aged seventeen to thirty who were tall and strong, registered and paid provisions, hence called ration-archers.

units.zh: 其首領則有將節、承局、什將等名，而皆統于隨路都兵馬總管府焉。
units.en: Their leaders held titles such as command token, bureau receiver, and squad chief, all under the circuit-wide Commanders-in-Chief of Troops and Horses.
units.literal: Their leaders bore titles such as command token, bureau receiver, and squad chief, and all were under the circuit-wide Commanders-in-Chief of Troops and Horses.

units.zh: 金之所以禮臣下、足任使者，其亦先代之遣法歟？
units.en: That the Jin thus honored subordinates and equipped envoys—was this too a practice inherited from earlier dynasties?
units.literal: That the Jin thereby honored subordinates and sufficed for envoys—was this also a transmitted method of earlier dynasties?

units.zh: 外任官從己人力，諸京留守、大興府尹，五十人。
units.en: Personal manpower for external officials: capital guardians and the magistrate of Daxing had fifty men.
units.literal: Personal manpower for external officials: capital guardians and magistrate of Daxing, fifty men.

units.zh: 統軍、都轉運、招討、按察使，諸路兵馬都總管，四十五人。
units.en: Army supervisors, transport directors, pacification commissioners, investigation commissioners, and circuit commanders-in-chief: forty-five men.
units.literal: Army supervisors, transport directors, pacification commissioners, investigation commissioners, and circuit commanders-in-chief of troops and horses, forty-five men.

units.zh: 轉運、節度使，四十人。
units.en: Transport commissioners and military governors: forty men.
units.literal: Transport commissioners and military governors, forty men.

units.zh: 提控、諸群牧、防禦使，三十五人。
units.en: Supervisory controllers, herd commissioners, and defense commissioners: thirty-five men.
units.literal: Supervisory controllers, all herd commissioners, and defense commissioners, thirty-five men.

units.zh: 外任親王傅、同知留守、副統軍、按察副使、諸州剌史知軍事，三十人。
units.en: External princely tutors, vice guardians, vice army supervisors, vice investigation commissioners, and prefects governing military affairs: thirty men.
units.literal: External princely tutors, vice guardians, vice army supervisors, vice investigation commissioners, and prefects concurrently governing military affairs, thirty men.

units.zh: 同知都轉運使事、副招討、副留守、同知府尹兼總管，提舉漕運司，諸五品鹽使，二十五人。
units.en: Vice transport directors, vice pacification commissioners, vice guardians, vice prefects serving as commanders-in-chief, directors of grain transport, and fifth-rank salt commissioners: twenty-five men.
units.literal: Vice transport directors, vice pacification commissioners, vice guardians, vice prefects concurrently serving as commanders-in-chief, directors of grain transport, and all fifth-rank salt commissioners, twenty-five men.

units.zh: 都轉運副使、按察司簽事、少尹、副總管、同知轉運節度使事，二十人。
units.en: Vice directors of transport, investigation bureau signatories, vice magistrates, vice commanders-in-chief, and vice transport and military governors: twenty men.
units.literal: Vice directors of transport, investigation bureau signatories, vice magistrates, vice commanders-in-chief, and vice transport and military governors, twenty men.

units.zh: 京都兵馬都指揮使，一十八人。
units.en: Capital commanders-in-chief of troops and horses: eighteen men.
units.literal: Capital commanders-in-chief of troops and horses, eighteen men.

units.zh: 轉運節度副使，十七人。
units.en: Vice transport and military governors: seventeen men.
units.literal: Vice transport and military governors, seventeen men.

units.zh: 兵馬都鈐轄，十五人。
units.en: Chief seal-holders of troops and horses: fifteen men.
units.literal: Chief seal-holders of troops and horses, fifteen men.

units.zh: 親王府尉、諸京留守總判官、同知防禦使事，十三人。
units.en: Princely mansion commandants, chief judges of capital guardians, and vice defense commissioners: thirteen men.
units.literal: Princely mansion commandants, chief judges of capital guardians, and vice defense commissioners, thirteen men.

units.zh: 警巡使、兵馬副都指揮、同提舉漕運司，正六品，鹽副使，從六品，酒麴鹽稅使、同知州軍事，一十人。
units.en: Patrol commissioners, vice commanders-in-chief, co-directors of grain transport, vice salt commissioners, wine-leaven salt-tax commissioners, and vice prefects governing military affairs: ten men.
units.literal: Patrol commissioners, vice commanders-in-chief of troops and horses, co-directors of grain transport (sixth positive rank), vice salt commissioners (sixth negative rank), wine-leaven salt-tax commissioners, and vice prefects governing military affairs, ten men.

units.zh: 統軍都轉運司京府總管散府等判官、京推官，九人。
units.en: Judges of army supervisory, transport, capital commanders-in-chief, and scattered prefectural offices, and capital investigating officers: nine men.
units.literal: Judges of army supervisory offices, transport offices, capital commanders-in-chief, scattered prefectures, and capital investigating officers, nine men.

units.zh: 親王府司馬、招討判官，赤劇縣令，提舉上京皇城兵馬鈐轄，正七品，酒麴鹽稅副使、都轉運判官、府推官、節度觀察判官，八人。
units.en: Princely mansion marshals, pacification judges, magistrates of major counties, directors of Shangjing imperial-city troops, vice wine-leaven salt-tax commissioners, transport judges, prefectural investigating officers, and military observation judges: eight men.
units.literal: Princely mansion marshals, pacification judges, magistrates of major counties, directors of Shangjing imperial-city troops (seventh positive rank), vice wine-leaven salt-tax commissioners, transport judges, prefectural investigating officers, and military observation judges, eight men.

units.zh: 京縣次劇縣令、都巡檢使、正將、府軍都指揮使，七人。
units.en: Magistrates of capital and secondary major counties, chief inspection commissioners, chief officers, and prefectural army commanders-in-chief: seven men.
units.literal: Magistrates of capital counties and secondary major counties, chief inspection commissioners, chief officers, and prefectural army commanders-in-chief, seven men.

units.zh: 司屬令、親王府文學、招討司勘事官、諸縣令、警巡副使、知城堡寨鎮，從七品、鹽判、同提舉上京皇城、節鎮軍都指揮使、都巡河、同七品酒使、防禦判官，六人。
units.en: Directorate of Attendants directors, princely literary officers, pacification investigation officers, county magistrates, vice patrol commissioners, fort administrators, salt judges, co-directors of Shangjing imperial city, circuit army commanders, river patrol directors, wine commissioners, and defense judges: six men.
units.literal: Directorate of Attendants directors, princely literary officers, pacification investigation officers, county magistrates, vice patrol commissioners, fort and market administrators (seventh negative rank), salt judges, co-directors of Shangjing imperial city, circuit army commanders-in-chief, river patrol directors, seventh-rank wine commissioners, and defense judges, six men.

units.zh: 市令、錄事、赤劇縣丞、副都巡檢使、副將、都巡檢、州軍判官，五人。
units.en: Market directors, registrars, assistant magistrates of major counties, vice chief inspection commissioners, vice officers, inspection commissioners, and prefectural army judges: five men.
units.literal: Market directors, registrars, assistant magistrates of major counties, vice chief inspection commissioners, vice officers, inspection commissioners, and prefectural army judges, five men.

units.zh: 統軍司知事、親王府記室參軍，司屬丞，正八品，酒使副、京縣次劇縣丞、諸司使，四人。
units.en: Army supervisory clerks, princely secretaries, Directorate assistants, vice wine commissioners, assistant magistrates of capital secondary major counties, and bureau commissioners: four men.
units.literal: Army supervisory bureau clerks, princely secretaries, Directorate of Attendants assistants (eighth positive rank), vice wine commissioners, assistant magistrates of capital secondary major counties, and bureau commissioners, four men.

units.zh: 大興府招討、按察司知事、京府運司節鎮司獄、管勾河橋關度譏察官，從八品，鹽判官、漕運司勾當官、警巡判官、諸縣丞、市丞、司候、主簿、錄事司判官、縣尉、副都巡檢、諸巡檢、巡河官，正九品，酒使、諸司副使，三人。
units.en: Daxing pacification officers, investigation clerks, prison officers, pass inspection officers, salt judges, grain-transport administrators, patrol judges, county assistants, market and gate officers, chief clerks, constables, inspection officers, river patrol officers, wine commissioners, and vice bureau commissioners: three men.
units.literal: Daxing pacification officers, investigation bureau clerks, capital transport and circuit prison officers, river-bridge and pass inspection officers (eighth negative rank), salt judges, grain-transport administrators, patrol judges, county assistants, market assistants, gatekeepers, chief clerks, registrar judges, county constables, vice inspection commissioners, inspection officers, river patrol officers (ninth positive rank), wine commissioners, and vice bureau commissioners, three men.

units.zh: 鹽場管勾、防刺以下司獄、部隊將、同管勾河橋、副譏察、司候判官、教授、統軍按察司知法、軍轄、諸司都監、節鎮以上知法，二人。
units.en: Salt-field administrators, lower prison officers, unit commanders, river-bridge co-administrators, vice inspection officers, gatekeeper judges, instructors, legal clerks, military controllers, bureau supervisors, and circuit legal clerks: two men.
units.literal: Salt-field administrators, prison officers below defense commissioners, unit commanders, co-administrators of river bridges, vice inspection officers, gatekeeper judges, instructors, army and investigation legal clerks, military controllers, bureau chief supervisors, and circuit legal clerks, two men.

units.zh: 鹽場同管勾、防刺以下知法、諸司同監、統軍按察司書史、統軍司譯書通事，一人。
units.en: Co-administrators of salt fields, lower legal clerks, vice bureau supervisors, army and investigation scribes, and army translators: one man.
units.literal: Co-administrators of salt fields, legal clerks below defense commissioners, vice bureau supervisors, army and investigation scribes, and army translators and interpreters, one man.

units.zh: 婆速公使、從己人力，于附近東京澄州招募漢人百姓投充。
units.en: Public envoys and personal manpower for Posu were filled by recruiting Han commoners near the Eastern Capital, Chengzhou.
units.literal: Public envoys and personal manpower for Posu were recruited from Han commoners near the Eastern Capital, Chengzhou, to fill the posts.

units.zh: 謂非猛安謀克所管者。
units.en: This applied to areas not under meng'an and mouke jurisdiction.
units.literal: This refers to those not under meng'an and mouke jurisdiction.

units.zh: 合懶、恤品、胡裏改、蒲與路並于各管猛安謀克所管上中戶內輸差驅丁，依射糧軍例支給錢糧，周年一易。
units.en: The Helan, Xupin, Hurigai, and Puyu circuits likewise rotated corvée laborers from upper and middle households under each meng'an and mouke, paid them as ration-archers, and replaced them annually.
units.literal: Helan, Xupin, Hurigai, and Puyu circuits likewise rotated corvée laborers from upper and middle households under each meng'an and mouke, paid provisions according to the ration-archer precedent, and replaced them annually.

units.zh: 部羅火、土魯渾紮石合亦同。
units.en: Buluohuo and Tulu Hun Zhazhihe followed the same rule.
units.literal: Buluohuo and Tulu Hun Zhazhihe were the same.

units.zh: 其諸颭及群牧官員，若猛安謀克應差本管戶民充人力者，並上中戶輪當。
units.en: For postal stations and herd officials, when meng'an and mouke assigned registered households as manpower, upper and middle households took turns.
units.literal: For all postal stations and herd officials, when meng'an and mouke were to assign registered households as manpower, upper and middle households rotated duty.

units.zh: 諸內外官有兼職各應得人從者，從多給，餘各驗品類差。
units.en: Officials with concurrent posts entitled to attendants received the larger allotment; the remainder was adjusted by rank.
units.literal: For all inner and outer officials holding concurrent posts each entitled to attendants, the larger allotment was granted; the remainder was adjusted by verifying rank categories.

units.zh: 諸親王引接、引從，在都兵馬司差，公主隨朝者從守部本破內差，外路者並所在州府就差。
units.en: Princes' reception and guide escorts were assigned by the capital troops office; princesses at court were drawn from the guardian department's personal attendants; those on external circuits were assigned locally.
units.literal: Princes' reception escorts and guide escorts were assigned by the capital troops office; princesses attending court were drawn from the guardian department's personal attendants; those on external circuits were assigned by the local prefecture.

units.zh: 諸王府引從、相府牽攏官、引接，周年替代，自余十月滿代，並以射糧軍充。
units.en: Princely guide escorts, the chief councillor's carriage-handlers, and reception escorts rotated annually; others served ten-month terms; all were ration-archer troops.
units.literal: Princely mansions' guide escorts, chief councillor's carriage-handlers, and reception escorts were replaced annually; the rest served full ten-month terms; all were filled by ration-archer troops.

units.zh: 諸隨朝六品以下職官、並諸局承應者，願令從己輸庸者聽，仍具姓名申部，本處官司周年內不得占使。
units.en: Court officials of sixth rank and below and bureau attendants could supply corvée through personal manpower if they reported names to the ministry; local offices could not requisition them within the year.
units.literal: For all court officials of sixth rank and below and all bureau attendants, those wishing to supply corvée through personal manpower were permitted, but names had to be reported to the ministry, and local offices could not requisition them within the year.

units.zh: 諸職官之任、以理去官者，接送人力於從己人內給半，取接者皆於所在官司出給印券差取，送還者須到本所給券發還，如無驗者權閣支請，候會問別無逃亡將帶，然後放支。
units.en: Officials taking or properly leaving office received half their escort from personal manpower; local offices issued sealed warrants for receiving escorts; return escorts required warrants from the original office; unverified cases were held until inquiry confirmed no desertion, then paid.
units.literal: For officials taking office or leaving office on proper grounds, escort manpower was half drawn from personal manpower; those receiving escorts were all dispatched by local offices with sealed warrants; return escorts had to reach the original office to have warrants issued back; if unverified, payment was temporarily withheld until inquiry confirmed no flight or unauthorized removal, then released.

units.zh: 諸致仕官職俱至三品者，從己人力於願往處給半，不得輸庸。
units.en: Retired officials whose highest rank reached third rank received half personal manpower at their chosen residence and could not substitute corvée.
units.literal: For all retired officials whose highest rank reached third rank, half personal manpower was granted at the place they wished to go; corvée substitution was not permitted.

units.zh: 身故應送還者又減半給之，若年未六十而致仕及罷去者，則不給。
units.en: If death required a return escort, the grant was further reduced by half; those who retired or were dismissed before age sixty received none.
units.literal: For those whose death required a return escort, the grant was further reduced by half; if retirement or dismissal came before age sixty, none was granted.
